            '-Dlog4j2.configurationFile='+str(self.home/'config/log4j2.yaml'),
            '-Dkafka.logs.dir='+str(self.root/'java-logs'),'-cp',str(self.home/'libs/*')]
        self.cluster_id=base64.urlsafe_b64encode(uuid.uuid4().bytes).decode().rstrip('=')
        for n in self.controller_ids+self.broker_ids:
            controller=n in self.controller_ids
            node=self.root/str(n);node.mkdir()
            settings={'process.roles':'controller' if controller else 'broker','node.id':str(n),
                'controller.quorum.voters':voters,'controller.listener.names':'CONTROLLER',
                'listener.security.protocol.map':'PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT'+(',SASL_PLAINTEXT:SASL_PLAINTEXT' if sasl else ''),
                'inter.broker.listener.name':'PLAINTEXT','log.dirs':str(node/'data'),
                'num.partitions':'2','offsets.topic.replication.factor':str(min(brokers,3)),
                'offsets.topic.num.partitions':'1','transaction.state.log.replication.factor':str(min(brokers,3)),
                'transaction.state.log.min.isr':'1','transaction.state.log.num.partitions':'1',
                'group.initial.rebalance.delay.ms':'0','auto.create.topics.enable':'false',
                'num.network.threads':'2','num.io.threads':'2','replica.lag.time.max.ms':'2000',
                'replica.fetch.wait.max.ms':'100','replica.socket.timeout.ms':'3000',
                'log.retention.check.interval.ms':'200','log.segment.delete.delay.ms':'100',
                'log.retention.ms':'-1',
                'log.cleaner.dedupe.buffer.size':'16777216',
                'controlled.shutdown.enable':'true'}
            if controller:
                settings['listeners']=f'CONTROLLER://127.0.0.1:{self.controller_ports[n]}'
            else:
                settings['listeners']=f'PLAINTEXT://127.0.0.1:{self.broker_ports[n]}'
                if sasl:settings['listeners']+=f',SASL_PLAINTEXT://127.0.0.1:{self.sasl_ports[n]}'
                settings['advertised.listeners']=settings['listeners']
                settings.update(overrides or {})
            if sasl:
                settings.update({'authorizer.class.name':'org.apache.kafka.metadata.authorizer.StandardAuthorizer',
                    'super.users':'User:admin;User:ANONYMOUS','allow.everyone.if.no.acl.found':'false'})
                if not controller:
                    settings['sasl.enabled.mechanisms']='PLAIN'
                    settings['listener.name.sasl_plaintext.plain.sasl.jaas.config']=(
                        'org.apache.kafka.common.security.plain.PlainLoginModule required '
                        f'user_admin="{self.password}" user_reader="{self.password}";')
            conf=node/'server.properties';conf.write_text(''.join(f'{k}={v}\n' for k,v in settings.items()))
            self.configs[n]=conf
            p=subprocess.run(self.command+['kafka.tools.StorageTool','format','--cluster-id='+self.cluster_id,'-c',str(conf)],
                text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=20)
            assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
        (self.root/'client.properties').write_text('request.timeout.ms=2000\ndefault.api.timeout.ms=3000\n')
        (self.root/'cli-log4j2.xml').write_text('<Configuration status="ERROR"><Appenders><Console name="stderr" target="SYSTEM_ERR"><PatternLayout pattern="%m%n"/></Console></Appenders><Loggers><Root level="error"><AppenderRef ref="stderr"/></Root></Loggers></Configuration>')

    def start(self,n):
        assert n in self.configs and (n not in self.processes or self.processes[n].poll() is not None)
        log=open(self.root/str(n)/'server.log','a+')
        expected_parent=os.getpid()
        def guard():
            if ctypes.CDLL(None).prctl(1,signal.SIGKILL,0,0,0)!=0 or os.getppid()!=expected_parent:os._exit(125)
        cmd=self.command+['kafka.Kafka',str(self.configs[n])]
        p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=log,start_new_session=True,preexec_fn=guard)
        self.processes[n]=p;self.logs[n]=log
        ports=[self.controller_ports[n]] if n in self.controller_ids else [self.broker_ports[n]]+([self.sasl_ports[n]] if n in self.sasl_ports else [])
        manifest={'event':'start','pid':p.pid,'pgid':p.pid,'directory':str(self.root),
            'node_id':n,'ports':ports,'command':cmd}
        resource_event(manifest)
        print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_START:'+json.dumps({k:v for k,v in manifest.items() if k not in ('event','command')}),flush=True)

    def stop(self,n):
        p=self.processes[n]
        if p.poll() is None:
            os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
            try:p.wait(timeout=8)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);p.wait(timeout=5)
        self.logs[n].close()
        resource_event({'event':'process_reaped','pid':p.pid,'node_id':n})
        print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_PROCESS_REAPED:'+str(p.pid),flush=True)

    def ready(self, expected=None, timeout=35):
        expected=set(expected if expected is not None else self.broker_ids)
        a=AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0});deadline=time.monotonic()+timeout
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            for n,p in self.processes.items():
                if p.poll() is not None and n in expected:
                    raise AssertionError((self.root/str(n)/'server.log').read_text()[-6000:])
            try:
                md=a.list_topics(timeout=2)
                if expected<=set(md.brokers):return a
            except KafkaException as e:
                if e.args[0].code() not in (-195,-187,-185,-158,14,15,16):raise
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise AssertionError('native cluster readiness timeout: '+str(expected))

    def create(self,partitions=1,replicas=None,config=None,assignment=None):
        a=AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0});name='s02c-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
        spec=NewTopic(name,partitions,replicas or len(self.broker_ids),config=config or {}) if assignment is None else NewTopic(name,len(assignment),replica_assignment=assignment,config=config or {})
        a.create_topics([spec])[name].result(10)
        for part in range(len(assignment) if assignment else partitions):
            self.wait_isr(name,len(assignment[part]) if assignment else replicas or len(self.broker_ids),p=part)
        return name

    def partition(self,name,p=0):
        return AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0}).list_topics(name,timeout=3).topics[name].partitions[p]

    def wait_isr(self,name,count,p=0,timeout=15):
        deadline=time.monotonic()+timeout
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            try:
                md=self.partition(name,p)
                if md.leader>=0 and len(md.isrs)==count:return md
            except (KafkaException,KeyError):pass
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise AssertionError('ISR did not reach '+str(count))

    def cli(self,main,args,timeout=12):
        cmd=self.command+['-Dlog4j2.configurationFile='+str(self.root/'cli-log4j2.xml'),main,*args]
        result=subprocess.run(cmd,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout)
        print('NATIVE_CLI:'+json.dumps({'command':cmd,'rc':result.returncode,'output':result.stdout[-3500:],'stderr':result.stderr[-1500:]}),flush=True)
        return result

    def quorum_command(self):
        return self.command+['-Dlog4j2.configurationFile='+str(self.root/'cli-log4j2.xml'),'org.apache.kafka.tools.MetadataQuorumCommand','--bootstrap-controller',self.controller_bootstrap,
            '--command-config',str(self.root/'client.properties'),'describe','--status']


@contextlib.contextmanager
def cluster(brokers=3,controllers=1,overrides=None,sasl=False):
    d=None
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='session02-kafka-c-') as d:
            box=NativeCluster(d,brokers,controllers,overrides,sasl)
            try:
                for n in box.controller_ids+box.broker_ids:box.start(n)
                box.ready()
                print('NATIVE_KAFKA_4_CLUSTER_READY:'+json.dumps({'brokers':box.broker_ids,'controllers':box.controller_ids}),flush=True)
                yield box
            finally:
                for n in box.broker_ids+box.controller_ids:
                    if n in box.processes:box.stop(n)
    finally:
        if d is not None:
            assert not Path(d).exists()
            resource_event({'event':'directory_removed','directory':d})
            print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY_REMOVED:'+d,flush=True)

title: KRaft元数据仲裁与数据分区ISR为什么要分别监控？
answer: 前者维护集群元数据共识，后者维护各分区数据复制健康。数据副本正常不代表可进行控制操作；监控controller quorum、元数据延迟以及分区ISR，分别设计恢复路径。
source: OpsForge 原创编审 2026-10-21；Apache Kafka 4.0 官方文档核对
review_note: 作者制作候选；独立复核及统一登记未完成。
body:
## 原题要求
以Apache Kafka 4.0及明确指定的客户端协议为背景；说明机制、证据及验收标准。应用变更只交开发实施。

## 操作任务
实现health(admin,topic,quorum_command)，从真实Admin分区元数据和给定官方MetadataQuorumCommand --status命令分别读取健康。返回quorum_available、controller_leader、metadata_high_watermark、metadata_max_follower_lag、voters（排序id）、under_replicated与offline（排序分区号）。原生CLI失败或6秒超时，quorum_available=False，未知字段保留None/空列表，不伪造0；CLI正常则解析实际LeaderId/HighWatermark/MaxFollowerLag/CurrentVoters。项目使用3个独立controller与3个数据broker：单controller滞后时元数据lag可见；controller多数失效时既有RF3数据读写仍可正常、控制操作失败；只停数据broker时quorum正常而ISR缩小。分别恢复，不把ISR正常当元数据仲裁健康。

## 提交产物
solution.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py

## 边界
真实3独立controller+3数据broker，官方quorum CLI、实际控制请求、RF3生产ACK和ISR故障。仅本机进程级故障，不声称跨故障域容灾或长期稳定性。
rubric: 核心机制准确，说明适用前提
给出可观察的验收结果并说明必要边界

exercise.validation_scope: 真实3独立controller+3数据broker，官方quorum CLI、实际控制请求、RF3生产ACK和ISR故障。仅本机进程级故障，不声称跨故障域容灾或长期稳定性。

def port():

        s.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return s.getsockname()[1]


@contextlib.contextmanager
def broker():
    home = Path(os.environ.get('OPSFORGE_KAFKA_HOME', '/opt/kafka'))
    java = Path(os.environ.get('JAVA_HOME', '/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64')) / 'bin/java'
    assert (home / 'libs/kafka_2.13-4.0.0.jar').is_file(), 'actual Kafka 4.0.0 required'
    assert java.is_file(), 'explicit Java runtime required'
    version = subprocess.run([str(java), '-version'], text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=5)
    assert version.returncode == 0 and '64-Bit' in version.stderr, version.stderr
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='session02-kafka-') as d:
        root = Path(d)
        a, b = port(), port()
        while a == b:
            b = port()
        bootstrap = f'127.0.0.1:{a}'
        conf = root / 'server.properties'
        conf.write_text('\n'.join([
            'process.roles=broker,controller', 'node.id=1',
            f'controller.quorum.voters=1@127.0.0.1:{b}',
            f'listeners=PLAINTEXT://{bootstrap},CONTROLLER://127.0.0.1:{b}',
            f'advertised.listeners=PLAINTEXT://{bootstrap}',
            'listener.security.protocol.map=PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT',
            'controller.listener.names=CONTROLLER', 'inter.broker.listener.name=PLAINTEXT',
            f'log.dirs={root}/data', 'num.partitions=2',
            'offsets.topic.replication.factor=1', 'offsets.topic.num.partitions=1',
            'transaction.state.log.replication.factor=1', 'transaction.state.log.min.isr=1',
            'transaction.state.log.num.partitions=1', 'group.initial.rebalance.delay.ms=0',
            'auto.create.topics.enable=false', 'num.network.threads=2', 'num.io.threads=2',
            'transaction.abort.timed.out.transaction.cleanup.interval.ms=200',
        ]) + '\n')
        cmd = [str(java), '-Xms64m', '-Xmx256m', '-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1',
               '-Dlog4j2.configurationFile=' + str(home/'config/log4j2.yaml'),
               '-cp', str(home/'libs/*')]
        formatted = subprocess.run(cmd + ['kafka.tools.StorageTool', 'format',
            '--cluster-id=' + base64.urlsafe_b64encode(uuid.uuid4().bytes).decode().rstrip('='),
            '-c', str(conf)], text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
        assert formatted.returncode == 0, formatted.stdout + formatted.stderr
        with (root/'broker.log').open('w+') as log:
            expected_parent = os.getpid()
            def parent_guard():
                if ctypes.CDLL(None).prctl(1, signal.SIGTERM, 0, 0, 0) != 0:
                    os._exit(125)
                if os.getppid() != expected_parent:
                    os._exit(125)
            p = subprocess.Popen(cmd + ['kafka.Kafka', str(conf)], stdout=log, stderr=log,
                                 start_new_session=True, preexec_fn=parent_guard)
            manifest = {'pid': p.pid, 'pgid': p.pid, 'directory': str(root),
                        'ports': [a,b], 'command': cmd + ['kafka.Kafka', str(conf)]}
            print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_START:' + json.dumps(manifest), flush=True)
            try:
                deadline = time.monotonic()+35
                while True:
                    if p.poll() is not None:
                        log.seek(0)
                        raise AssertionError(log.read()[-6000:])
                    try:
                        with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1', a), timeout=.2):
                            break
                    except OSError:
                        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                            log.seek(0)
                            raise AssertionError('broker startup timeout: '+log.read()[-6000:])
                        time.sleep(.1)
                admin = AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers': bootstrap, 'log_level': 0})
                metadata_deadline = time.monotonic()+15
                while True:
                    try:
                        if admin.list_topics(timeout=2).brokers:
                            break
                    except KafkaException as exc:
                        code = exc.args[0].code()
                        if code not in (-195,-187,-185,14,15,16):
                            raise
                        print('NATIVE_METADATA_READINESS_RETRY:'+str(code), flush=True)
                    if time.monotonic() >= metadata_deadline:
                        raise AssertionError('native metadata readiness timeout')
                    if p.poll() is not None:
                        log.seek(0)
                        raise AssertionError('broker exited: '+log.read()[-3000:])
                    time.sleep(.08)
                print('NATIVE_KAFKA_4_READY:'+bootstrap, flush=True)
                yield bootstrap
            finally:
                if p.poll() is None:
                    os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                    try:
                        p.wait(timeout=10)
                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                        os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGKILL)

                assert p.poll() is not None

        assert not any(path.name == 'core' for path in root.iterdir())
    assert not root.exists()
    print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY_REMOVED:'+str(root), flush=True)


def topic(bs, count=2, config=None):
    name = 's02-' + uuid.uuid4().hex
    a = AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers': bs, 'log_level': 0})
    a.create_topics([NewTopic(name, count, 1, config=config or {})])[name].result(10)
    return name


def producer(bs, **extra):
    return Producer({'bootstrap.servers': bs, 'log_level': 0,
                     'message.timeout.ms': 5000, **extra})


def send(bs, name, records):
    p = producer(bs)
    errors = []
    for part, value, timestamp in records:
        p.produce(name, partition=part, value=value, timestamp=timestamp,
                  on_delivery=lambda e,m: errors.append(e))
    assert p.flush(10) == 0
    assert len(errors) == len(records) and not any(errors), errors


def consumer(bs, group=None, **extra):
    return Consumer({'bootstrap.servers': bs, 'group.id': group or uuid.uuid4().hex,
                     'enable.auto.commit': False, 'auto.offset.reset': 'earliest',
                     'log_level': 0, **extra})


def read(c, name, partition=0, offset=0, count=1, timeout=8):
    c.assign([TopicPartition(name, partition, offset)])
    rows = []
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    while len(rows)<count and time.monotonic()<deadline:
        m = c.poll(.1)
        if m is not None:
            assert not m.error(), m.error()
            rows.append(m)
    return rows


def committed(bs, group, name, partitions):
    c = consumer(bs, group)
    try:
        return [x.offset for x in coordinator_retry(lambda:
            c.committed([TopicPartition(name,p) for p in partitions],timeout=2))]
    finally:
        c.close()


def set_offsets(bs, group, name, values):
    c = consumer(bs, group)
    try:
        coordinator_retry(lambda: c.commit(offsets=[TopicPartition(name,p,v)
            for p,v in enumerate(values)],asynchronous=False))
    finally:
        c.close()


def coordinator_retry(operation):
    """Retry only native coordinator discovery transitions, never semantic errors."""
    deadline = time.monotonic()+6
    while True:
        try:
            return operation()
        except KafkaException as exc:
            error = exc.args[0]
            if error.code() not in (14,15,16) or time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                raise
            print('NATIVE_COORDINATOR_REDISCOVERY:'+str(error.code()), flush=True)
            time.sleep(.08)


def traced(f):
    def invoke(*args, **kwargs):
        print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:'+f.__name__, flush=True)
        try:
            result = f(*args, **kwargs)
        except BaseException:
            print('STUDENT_OPERATION_RAISED:'+f.__name__, flush=True)
            raise
        print('STUDENT_OPERATION_RETURNED:'+f.__name__, flush=True)
        return result
    return invoke

"""Batch C only: real separated KRaft controllers and data brokers."""
from confluent_kafka import TopicCollection


def resource_event(row):
    path=Path.cwd()/'checks/native-c-resources.jsonl'
    path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with path.open('a') as stream:stream.write(json.dumps(row)+'\n')


class NativeCluster:
    def __init__(self, root, brokers, controllers, overrides=None, sasl=False):
        self.root=Path(root)
        self.home=Path(os.environ.get('OPSFORGE_KAFKA_HOME') or os.environ.get('KAFKA_HOME') or '/opt/kafka')
        self.java=Path(os.environ.get('JAVA_HOME') or '/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64')/'bin/java'
        assert (self.home/'libs/kafka_2.13-4.0.0.jar').is_file()
        self.broker_ids=list(range(1,brokers+1));self.controller_ids=list(range(101,101+controllers))
        used=set()
        def allocate():
            while True:
                number=port()
                if number not in used:used.add(number);return number
        self.controller_ports={n:allocate() for n in self.controller_ids}
        self.broker_ports={n:allocate() for n in self.broker_ids}
        self.sasl_ports={n:allocate() for n in self.broker_ids} if sasl else {}
        self.bootstrap=','.join(f'127.0.0.1:{self.broker_ports[n]}' for n in self.broker_ids)
        self.controller_bootstrap=','.join(f'127.0.0.1:{self.controller_ports[n]}' for n in self.controller_ids)
        self.sasl_bootstrap=','.join(f'127.0.0.1:{self.sasl_ports[n]}' for n in self.broker_ids) if sasl else None
        self.password='s02-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.processes={};self.logs={};self.configs={};self.commands={}
        voters=','.join(f'{n}@127.0.0.1:{self.controller_ports[n]}' for n in self.controller_ids)
        self.command=[str(self.java),'-Xms32m','-Xmx256m','-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1',
            '-Dlog4j2.configurationFile='+str(self.home/'config/log4j2.yaml'),
            '-Dkafka.logs.dir='+str(self.root/'java-logs'),'-cp',str(self.home/'libs/*')]
        self.cluster_id=base64.urlsafe_b64encode(uuid.uuid4().bytes).decode().rstrip('=')
        for n in self.controller_ids+self.broker_ids:
            controller=n in self.controller_ids
            node=self.root/str(n);node.mkdir()
            settings={'process.roles':'controller' if controller else 'broker','node.id':str(n),
                'controller.quorum.voters':voters,'controller.listener.names':'CONTROLLER',
                'listener.security.protocol.map':'PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT'+(',SASL_PLAINTEXT:SASL_PLAINTEXT' if sasl else ''),
                'inter.broker.listener.name':'PLAINTEXT','log.dirs':str(node/'data'),
                'num.partitions':'2','offsets.topic.replication.factor':str(min(brokers,3)),
                'offsets.topic.num.partitions':'1','transaction.state.log.replication.factor':str(min(brokers,3)),
                'transaction.state.log.min.isr':'1','transaction.state.log.num.partitions':'1',
                'group.initial.rebalance.delay.ms':'0','auto.create.topics.enable':'false',
                'num.network.threads':'2','num.io.threads':'2','replica.lag.time.max.ms':'2000',
                'replica.fetch.wait.max.ms':'100','replica.socket.timeout.ms':'3000',
                'log.retention.check.interval.ms':'200','log.segment.delete.delay.ms':'100',
                'log.retention.ms':'-1',
                'log.cleaner.dedupe.buffer.size':'16777216',
                'controlled.shutdown.enable':'true'}
            if controller:
                settings['listeners']=f'CONTROLLER://127.0.0.1:{self.controller_ports[n]}'
            else:
                settings['listeners']=f'PLAINTEXT://127.0.0.1:{self.broker_ports[n]}'
                if sasl:settings['listeners']+=f',SASL_PLAINTEXT://127.0.0.1:{self.sasl_ports[n]}'
                settings['advertised.listeners']=settings['listeners']
                settings.update(overrides or {})
            if sasl:
                settings.update({'authorizer.class.name':'org.apache.kafka.metadata.authorizer.StandardAuthorizer',
                    'super.users':'User:admin;User:ANONYMOUS','allow.everyone.if.no.acl.found':'false'})
                if not controller:
                    settings['sasl.enabled.mechanisms']='PLAIN'
                    settings['listener.name.sasl_plaintext.plain.sasl.jaas.config']=(
                        'org.apache.kafka.common.security.plain.PlainLoginModule required '
                        f'user_admin="{self.password}" user_reader="{self.password}";')
            conf=node/'server.properties';conf.write_text(''.join(f'{k}={v}\n' for k,v in settings.items()))
            self.configs[n]=conf
            p=subprocess.run(self.command+['kafka.tools.StorageTool','format','--cluster-id='+self.cluster_id,'-c',str(conf)],
                text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=20)
            assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
        (self.root/'client.properties').write_text('request.timeout.ms=2000\ndefault.api.timeout.ms=3000\n')
        (self.root/'cli-log4j2.xml').write_text('<Configuration status="ERROR"><Appenders><Console name="stderr" target="SYSTEM_ERR"><PatternLayout pattern="%m%n"/></Console></Appenders><Loggers><Root level="error"><AppenderRef ref="stderr"/></Root></Loggers></Configuration>')

    def start(self,n):
        assert n in self.configs and (n not in self.processes or self.processes[n].poll() is not None)
        log=open(self.root/str(n)/'server.log','a+')
        expected_parent=os.getpid()
        def guard():
            if ctypes.CDLL(None).prctl(1,signal.SIGKILL,0,0,0)!=0 or os.getppid()!=expected_parent:os._exit(125)
        cmd=self.command+['kafka.Kafka',str(self.configs[n])]
        p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=log,start_new_session=True,preexec_fn=guard)
        self.processes[n]=p;self.logs[n]=log
        ports=[self.controller_ports[n]] if n in self.controller_ids else [self.broker_ports[n]]+([self.sasl_ports[n]] if n in self.sasl_ports else [])
        manifest={'event':'start','pid':p.pid,'pgid':p.pid,'directory':str(self.root),
            'node_id':n,'ports':ports,'command':cmd}
        resource_event(manifest)
        print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_START:'+json.dumps({k:v for k,v in manifest.items() if k not in ('event','command')}),flush=True)

    def stop(self,n):
        p=self.processes[n]
        if p.poll() is None:
            os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
            try:p.wait(timeout=8)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);p.wait(timeout=5)
        self.logs[n].close()
        resource_event({'event':'process_reaped','pid':p.pid,'node_id':n})
        print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_PROCESS_REAPED:'+str(p.pid),flush=True)

    def ready(self, expected=None, timeout=35):
        expected=set(expected if expected is not None else self.broker_ids)
        a=AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0});deadline=time.monotonic()+timeout
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            for n,p in self.processes.items():
                if p.poll() is not None and n in expected:
                    raise AssertionError((self.root/str(n)/'server.log').read_text()[-6000:])
            try:
                md=a.list_topics(timeout=2)
                if expected<=set(md.brokers):return a
            except KafkaException as e:
                if e.args[0].code() not in (-195,-187,-185,-158,14,15,16):raise
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise AssertionError('native cluster readiness timeout: '+str(expected))

    def create(self,partitions=1,replicas=None,config=None,assignment=None):
        a=AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0});name='s02c-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
        spec=NewTopic(name,partitions,replicas or len(self.broker_ids),config=config or {}) if assignment is None else NewTopic(name,len(assignment),replica_assignment=assignment,config=config or {})
        a.create_topics([spec])[name].result(10)
        for part in range(len(assignment) if assignment else partitions):
            self.wait_isr(name,len(assignment[part]) if assignment else replicas or len(self.broker_ids),p=part)
        return name

    def partition(self,name,p=0):
        return AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0}).list_topics(name,timeout=3).topics[name].partitions[p]

    def wait_isr(self,name,count,p=0,timeout=15):
        deadline=time.monotonic()+timeout
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            try:
                md=self.partition(name,p)
                if md.leader>=0 and len(md.isrs)==count:return md
            except (KafkaException,KeyError):pass
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise AssertionError('ISR did not reach '+str(count))

    def cli(self,main,args,timeout=12):
        cmd=self.command+['-Dlog4j2.configurationFile='+str(self.root/'cli-log4j2.xml'),main,*args]
        result=subprocess.run(cmd,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout)
        print('NATIVE_CLI:'+json.dumps({'command':cmd,'rc':result.returncode,'output':result.stdout[-3500:],'stderr':result.stderr[-1500:]}),flush=True)
        return result

    def quorum_command(self):
        return self.command+['-Dlog4j2.configurationFile='+str(self.root/'cli-log4j2.xml'),'org.apache.kafka.tools.MetadataQuorumCommand','--bootstrap-controller',self.controller_bootstrap,
            '--command-config',str(self.root/'client.properties'),'describe','--status']


@contextlib.contextmanager
def cluster(brokers=3,controllers=1,overrides=None,sasl=False):
    d=None
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='session02-kafka-c-') as d:
            box=NativeCluster(d,brokers,controllers,overrides,sasl)
            try:
                for n in box.controller_ids+box.broker_ids:box.start(n)
                box.ready()
                print('NATIVE_KAFKA_4_CLUSTER_READY:'+json.dumps({'brokers':box.broker_ids,'controllers':box.controller_ids}),flush=True)
                yield box
            finally:
                for n in box.broker_ids+box.controller_ids:
                    if n in box.processes:box.stop(n)
    finally:
        if d is not None:
            assert not Path(d).exists()
            resource_event({'event':'directory_removed','directory':d})

    assert java.is_file(), 'explicit Java runtime required'
    version = subprocess.run([str(java), '-version'], text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=5)
    assert version.returncode == 0 and '64-Bit' in version.stderr, version.stderr
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='session02-kafka-') as d:
        root = Path(d)
        a, b = port(), port()
        while a == b:
            b = port()
        bootstrap = f'127.0.0.1:{a}'
        conf = root / 'server.properties'

            'process.roles=broker,controller', 'node.id=1',

            'listener.security.protocol.map=PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT',

            f'log.dirs={root}/data', 'num.partitions=2',

            'transaction.state.log.replication.factor=1', 'transaction.state.log.min.isr=1',

            'auto.create.topics.enable=false', 'num.network.threads=2', 'num.io.threads=2',
            'transaction.abort.timed.out.transaction.cleanup.interval.ms=200',

        assert formatted.returncode == 0, formatted.stdout + formatted.stderr
        with (root/'broker.log').open('w+') as log:
            expected_parent = os.getpid()

                if ctypes.CDLL(None).prctl(1, signal.SIGTERM, 0, 0, 0) != 0:
                    os._exit(125)

            p = subprocess.Popen(cmd + ['kafka.Kafka', str(conf)], stdout=log, stderr=log,

                    if time.monotonic() >= metadata_deadline:

                    if p.poll() is not None:

def topic(bs, count=2, config=None):
    name = 's02-' + uuid.uuid4().hex
    a = AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers': bs, 'log_level': 0})
    a.create_topics([NewTopic(name, count, 1, config=config or {})])[name].result(10)
    return name


def producer(bs, **extra):
    return Producer({'bootstrap.servers': bs, 'log_level': 0,
                     'message.timeout.ms': 5000, **extra})


def send(bs, name, records):
    p = producer(bs)
    errors = []
    for part, value, timestamp in records:
        p.produce(name, partition=part, value=value, timestamp=timestamp,
                  on_delivery=lambda e,m: errors.append(e))
    assert p.flush(10) == 0
    assert len(errors) == len(records) and not any(errors), errors


def consumer(bs, group=None, **extra):
    return Consumer({'bootstrap.servers': bs, 'group.id': group or uuid.uuid4().hex,
                     'enable.auto.commit': False, 'auto.offset.reset': 'earliest',
                     'log_level': 0, **extra})


def read(c, name, partition=0, offset=0, count=1, timeout=8):
    c.assign([TopicPartition(name, partition, offset)])
    rows = []
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    while len(rows)<count and time.monotonic()<deadline:
        m = c.poll(.1)
        if m is not None:
            assert not m.error(), m.error()
            rows.append(m)
    return rows


def committed(bs, group, name, partitions):
    c = consumer(bs, group)
    try:
        return [x.offset for x in coordinator_retry(lambda:
            c.committed([TopicPartition(name,p) for p in partitions],timeout=2))]
    finally:
        c.close()


def set_offsets(bs, group, name, values):
    c = consumer(bs, group)
    try:
        coordinator_retry(lambda: c.commit(offsets=[TopicPartition(name,p,v)
            for p,v in enumerate(values)],asynchronous=False))
    finally:
        c.close()


def coordinator_retry(operation):
    """Retry only native coordinator discovery transitions, never semantic errors."""
    deadline = time.monotonic()+6
    while True:
        try:
            return operation()
        except KafkaException as exc:
            error = exc.args[0]
            if error.code() not in (14,15,16) or time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                raise
            print('NATIVE_COORDINATOR_REDISCOVERY:'+str(error.code()), flush=True)
            time.sleep(.08)


def traced(f):
    def invoke(*args, **kwargs):
        print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:'+f.__name__, flush=True)
        try:
            result = f(*args, **kwargs)
        except BaseException:
            print('STUDENT_OPERATION_RAISED:'+f.__name__, flush=True)
            raise
        print('STUDENT_OPERATION_RETURNED:'+f.__name__, flush=True)
        return result
    return invoke

"""Batch C only: real separated KRaft controllers and data brokers."""
from confluent_kafka import TopicCollection


def resource_event(row):
    path=Path.cwd()/'checks/native-c-resources.jsonl'
    path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with path.open('a') as stream:stream.write(json.dumps(row)+'\n')


class NativeCluster:
    def __init__(self, root, brokers, controllers, overrides=None, sasl=False):
        self.root=Path(root)
        self.home=Path(os.environ.get('OPSFORGE_KAFKA_HOME') or os.environ.get('KAFKA_HOME') or '/opt/kafka')
        self.java=Path(os.environ.get('JAVA_HOME') or '/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64')/'bin/java'
        assert (self.home/'libs/kafka_2.13-4.0.0.jar').is_file()
        self.broker_ids=list(range(1,brokers+1));self.controller_ids=list(range(101,101+controllers))
        used=set()
        def allocate():
            while True:
                number=port()
                if number not in used:used.add(number);return number
        self.controller_ports={n:allocate() for n in self.controller_ids}
        self.broker_ports={n:allocate() for n in self.broker_ids}
        self.sasl_ports={n:allocate() for n in self.broker_ids} if sasl else {}
        self.bootstrap=','.join(f'127.0.0.1:{self.broker_ports[n]}' for n in self.broker_ids)
        self.controller_bootstrap=','.join(f'127.0.0.1:{self.controller_ports[n]}' for n in self.controller_ids)
        self.sasl_bootstrap=','.join(f'127.0.0.1:{self.sasl_ports[n]}' for n in self.broker_ids) if sasl else None
        self.password='s02-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.processes={};self.logs={};self.configs={};self.commands={}
        voters=','.join(f'{n}@127.0.0.1:{self.controller_ports[n]}' for n in self.controller_ids)
        self.command=[str(self.java),'-Xms32m','-Xmx256m','-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1',
            '-Dlog4j2.configurationFile='+str(self.home/'config/log4j2.yaml'),
            '-Dkafka.logs.dir='+str(self.root/'java-logs'),'-cp',str(self.home/'libs/*')]
        self.cluster_id=base64.urlsafe_b64encode(uuid.uuid4().bytes).decode().rstrip('=')
        for n in self.controller_ids+self.broker_ids:
            controller=n in self.controller_ids
            node=self.root/str(n);node.mkdir()
            settings={'process.roles':'controller' if controller else 'broker','node.id':str(n),
                'controller.quorum.voters':voters,'controller.listener.names':'CONTROLLER',
                'listener.security.protocol.map':'PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT'+(',SASL_PLAINTEXT:SASL_PLAINTEXT' if sasl else ''),
                'inter.broker.listener.name':'PLAINTEXT','log.dirs':str(node/'data'),
                'num.partitions':'2','offsets.topic.replication.factor':str(min(brokers,3)),
                'offsets.topic.num.partitions':'1','transaction.state.log.replication.factor':str(min(brokers,3)),
                'transaction.state.log.min.isr':'1','transaction.state.log.num.partitions':'1',
                'group.initial.rebalance.delay.ms':'0','auto.create.topics.enable':'false',
                'num.network.threads':'2','num.io.threads':'2','replica.lag.time.max.ms':'2000',
                'replica.fetch.wait.max.ms':'100','replica.socket.timeout.ms':'3000',
                'log.retention.check.interval.ms':'200','log.segment.delete.delay.ms':'100',
                'log.retention.ms':'-1',
                'log.cleaner.dedupe.buffer.size':'16777216',
                'controlled.shutdown.enable':'true'}
            if controller:
                settings['listeners']=f'CONTROLLER://127.0.0.1:{self.controller_ports[n]}'
            else:
                settings['listeners']=f'PLAINTEXT://127.0.0.1:{self.broker_ports[n]}'
                if sasl:settings['listeners']+=f',SASL_PLAINTEXT://127.0.0.1:{self.sasl_ports[n]}'
                settings['advertised.listeners']=settings['listeners']
                settings.update(overrides or {})
            if sasl:
                settings.update({'authorizer.class.name':'org.apache.kafka.metadata.authorizer.StandardAuthorizer',
                    'super.users':'User:admin;User:ANONYMOUS','allow.everyone.if.no.acl.found':'false'})
                if not controller:
                    settings['sasl.enabled.mechanisms']='PLAIN'
                    settings['listener.name.sasl_plaintext.plain.sasl.jaas.config']=(
                        'org.apache.kafka.common.security.plain.PlainLoginModule required '
                        f'user_admin="{self.password}" user_reader="{self.password}";')
            conf=node/'server.properties';conf.write_text(''.join(f'{k}={v}\n' for k,v in settings.items()))
            self.configs[n]=conf
            p=subprocess.run(self.command+['kafka.tools.StorageTool','format','--cluster-id='+self.cluster_id,'-c',str(conf)],
                text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=20)
            assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
        (self.root/'client.properties').write_text('request.timeout.ms=2000\ndefault.api.timeout.ms=3000\n')
        (self.root/'cli-log4j2.xml').write_text('<Configuration status="ERROR"><Appenders><Console name="stderr" target="SYSTEM_ERR"><PatternLayout pattern="%m%n"/></Console></Appenders><Loggers><Root level="error"><AppenderRef ref="stderr"/></Root></Loggers></Configuration>')

    def start(self,n):
        assert n in self.configs and (n not in self.processes or self.processes[n].poll() is not None)
        log=open(self.root/str(n)/'server.log','a+')
        expected_parent=os.getpid()
        def guard():
            if ctypes.CDLL(None).prctl(1,signal.SIGKILL,0,0,0)!=0 or os.getppid()!=expected_parent:os._exit(125)
        cmd=self.command+['kafka.Kafka',str(self.configs[n])]
        p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=log,start_new_session=True,preexec_fn=guard)
        self.processes[n]=p;self.logs[n]=log
        ports=[self.controller_ports[n]] if n in self.controller_ids else [self.broker_ports[n]]+([self.sasl_ports[n]] if n in self.sasl_ports else [])
        manifest={'event':'start','pid':p.pid,'pgid':p.pid,'directory':str(self.root),
            'node_id':n,'ports':ports,'command':cmd}
        resource_event(manifest)
        print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_START:'+json.dumps({k:v for k,v in manifest.items() if k not in ('event','command')}),flush=True)

    def stop(self,n):
        p=self.processes[n]
        if p.poll() is None:
            os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
            try:p.wait(timeout=8)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);p.wait(timeout=5)
        self.logs[n].close()
        resource_event({'event':'process_reaped','pid':p.pid,'node_id':n})
        print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_PROCESS_REAPED:'+str(p.pid),flush=True)

    def ready(self, expected=None, timeout=35):
        expected=set(expected if expected is not None else self.broker_ids)
        a=AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0});deadline=time.monotonic()+timeout
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            for n,p in self.processes.items():
                if p.poll() is not None and n in expected:
                    raise AssertionError((self.root/str(n)/'server.log').read_text()[-6000:])
            try:
                md=a.list_topics(timeout=2)
                if expected<=set(md.brokers):return a
            except KafkaException as e:
                if e.args[0].code() not in (-195,-187,-185,-158,14,15,16):raise
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise AssertionError('native cluster readiness timeout: '+str(expected))

    def create(self,partitions=1,replicas=None,config=None,assignment=None):
        a=AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0});name='s02c-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
        spec=NewTopic(name,partitions,replicas or len(self.broker_ids),config=config or {}) if assignment is None else NewTopic(name,len(assignment),replica_assignment=assignment,config=config or {})
        a.create_topics([spec])[name].result(10)
        for part in range(len(assignment) if assignment else partitions):
            self.wait_isr(name,len(assignment[part]) if assignment else replicas or len(self.broker_ids),p=part)
        return name

    def partition(self,name,p=0):
        return AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0}).list_topics(name,timeout=3).topics[name].partitions[p]

    def wait_isr(self,name,count,p=0,timeout=15):
        deadline=time.monotonic()+timeout
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            try:
                md=self.partition(name,p)
                if md.leader>=0 and len(md.isrs)==count:return md
            except (KafkaException,KeyError):pass
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise AssertionError('ISR did not reach '+str(count))

    def cli(self,main,args,timeout=12):
        cmd=self.command+['-Dlog4j2.configurationFile='+str(self.root/'cli-log4j2.xml'),main,*args]
        result=subprocess.run(cmd,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout)
        print('NATIVE_CLI:'+json.dumps({'command':cmd,'rc':result.returncode,'output':result.stdout[-3500:],'stderr':result.stderr[-1500:]}),flush=True)
        return result

    def quorum_command(self):
        return self.command+['-Dlog4j2.configurationFile='+str(self.root/'cli-log4j2.xml'),'org.apache.kafka.tools.MetadataQuorumCommand','--bootstrap-controller',self.controller_bootstrap,
            '--command-config',str(self.root/'client.properties'),'describe','--status']


@contextlib.contextmanager
def cluster(brokers=3,controllers=1,overrides=None,sasl=False):
    d=None
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='session02-kafka-c-') as d:
            box=NativeCluster(d,brokers,controllers,overrides,sasl)
            try:
                for n in box.controller_ids+box.broker_ids:box.start(n)
                box.ready()
                print('NATIVE_KAFKA_4_CLUSTER_READY:'+json.dumps({'brokers':box.broker_ids,'controllers':box.controller_ids}),flush=True)
                yield box
            finally:
                for n in box.broker_ids+box.controller_ids:
                    if n in box.processes:box.stop(n)
    finally:
        if d is not None:
            assert not Path(d).exists()
            resource_event({'event':'directory_removed','directory':d})
            print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY_REMOVED:'+d,flush=True)

title: broker退役为什么要先迁出副本再移除节点？
answer: 直接移除会减少冗余并可能使领导者不可用；应按容量和故障域规划副本重分配，验证全部副本迁出及ISR健康。结束后再清理节点，不能只迁领导者。

## 原题要求
以Apache Kafka 4.0及明确指定的客户端协议为背景；说明机制、证据及验收标准。应用变更只交开发实施。

## 操作任务
实现evacuate(admin,reassign_command,retiring_broker,plan,path)。plan为官方重分配partitions数组；必须覆盖原生元数据中该broker的全部topic/partition副本，不能只迁leader。保留每分区副本数，目标必须唯一、存活且不含退役id；任何不完整/非法计划ValueError且不写plan文件、不改变分配。执行官方CLI后，等待原生全部topic没有残余退役副本、全部目标replicas和ISR一致才返回True；超时RuntimeError。已完成的相同计划可安全重复。函数仅出具可移除门禁，不删除进程或数据；可信验收在门禁通过后真正停止broker并回放所有历史记录，核对UUID不变。

## 提交产物
solution.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py

## 边界
真实3broker+独立controller、原生全部副本扫描、实际数据迁移、UUID保持和停止退役进程后的回放；不等同容量或可用区规划已经完成，生产故障域需额外验收。

"""Trusted fixture: actual Kafka 4.0.0, private loopback process and directory."""
import base64
import contextlib
import ctypes
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import socket
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import uuid
from confluent_kafka import Consumer, Producer, TopicPartition, KafkaException
from confluent_kafka.admin import AdminClient, NewTopic


def port():
    with socket.socket() as s:
        s.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return s.getsockname()[1]


@contextlib.contextmanager
def broker():
    home = Path(os.environ.get('OPSFORGE_KAFKA_HOME', '/opt/kafka'))
    java = Path(os.environ.get('JAVA_HOME', '/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64')) / 'bin/java'
    assert (home / 'libs/kafka_2.13-4.0.0.jar').is_file(), 'actual Kafka 4.0.0 required'
    assert java.is_file(), 'explicit Java runtime required'
    version = subprocess.run([str(java), '-version'], text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=5)
    assert version.returncode == 0 and '64-Bit' in version.stderr, version.stderr
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='session02-kafka-') as d:
        root = Path(d)
        a, b = port(), port()
        while a == b:
            b = port()
        bootstrap = f'127.0.0.1:{a}'
        conf = root / 'server.properties'
        conf.write_text('\n'.join([
            'process.roles=broker,controller', 'node.id=1',
            f'controller.quorum.voters=1@127.0.0.1:{b}',
            f'listeners=PLAINTEXT://{bootstrap},CONTROLLER://127.0.0.1:{b}',
            f'advertised.listeners=PLAINTEXT://{bootstrap}',
            'listener.security.protocol.map=PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT',
            'controller.listener.names=CONTROLLER', 'inter.broker.listener.name=PLAINTEXT',
            f'log.dirs={root}/data', 'num.partitions=2',
            'offsets.topic.replication.factor=1', 'offsets.topic.num.partitions=1',
            'transaction.state.log.replication.factor=1', 'transaction.state.log.min.isr=1',
            'transaction.state.log.num.partitions=1', 'group.initial.rebalance.delay.ms=0',
            'auto.create.topics.enable=false', 'num.network.threads=2', 'num.io.threads=2',
            'transaction.abort.timed.out.transaction.cleanup.interval.ms=200',
        ]) + '\n')
        cmd = [str(java), '-Xms64m', '-Xmx256m', '-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1',
               '-Dlog4j2.configurationFile=' + str(home/'config/log4j2.yaml'),
               '-cp', str(home/'libs/*')]
        formatted = subprocess.run(cmd + ['kafka.tools.StorageTool', 'format',
            '--cluster-id=' + base64.urlsafe_b64encode(uuid.uuid4().bytes).decode().rstrip('='),
            '-c', str(conf)], text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
        assert formatted.returncode == 0, formatted.stdout + formatted.stderr
        with (root/'broker.log').open('w+') as log:
            expected_parent = os.getpid()
            def parent_guard():
                if ctypes.CDLL(None).prctl(1, signal.SIGTERM, 0, 0, 0) != 0:
                    os._exit(125)
                if os.getppid() != expected_parent:
                    os._exit(125)
            p = subprocess.Popen(cmd + ['kafka.Kafka', str(conf)], stdout=log, stderr=log,
                                 start_new_session=True, preexec_fn=parent_guard)
            manifest = {'pid': p.pid, 'pgid': p.pid, 'directory': str(root),
                        'ports': [a,b], 'command': cmd + ['kafka.Kafka', str(conf)]}
            print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_START:' + json.dumps(manifest), flush=True)
            try:
                deadline = time.monotonic()+35
                while True:
                    if p.poll() is not None:
                        log.seek(0)
                        raise AssertionError(log.read()[-6000:])
                    try:
                        with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1', a), timeout=.2):
                            break
                    except OSError:
                        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                            log.seek(0)
                            raise AssertionError('broker startup timeout: '+log.read()[-6000:])
                        time.sleep(.1)
                admin = AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers': bootstrap, 'log_level': 0})
                metadata_deadline = time.monotonic()+15
                while True:
                    try:
                        if admin.list_topics(timeout=2).brokers:
                            break
                    except KafkaException as exc:
                        code = exc.args[0].code()
                        if code not in (-195,-187,-185,14,15,16):
                            raise
                        print('NATIVE_METADATA_READINESS_RETRY:'+str(code), flush=True)
                    if time.monotonic() >= metadata_deadline:
                        raise AssertionError('native metadata readiness timeout')
                    if p.poll() is not None:
                        log.seek(0)
                        raise AssertionError('broker exited: '+log.read()[-3000:])
                    time.sleep(.08)
                print('NATIVE_KAFKA_4_READY:'+bootstrap, flush=True)
                yield bootstrap
            finally:
                if p.poll() is None:
                    os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                    try:
                        p.wait(timeout=10)
                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                        os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                        p.wait(timeout=5)
                assert p.poll() is not None
                print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_PROCESS_REAPED:'+str(p.pid), flush=True)
        assert not any(path.name == 'core' for path in root.iterdir())
    assert not root.exists()
    print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY_REMOVED:'+str(root), flush=True)


def topic(bs, count=2, config=None):
    name = 's02-' + uuid.uuid4().hex
    a = AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers': bs, 'log_level': 0})
    a.create_topics([NewTopic(name, count, 1, config=config or {})])[name].result(10)
    return name


def producer(bs, **extra):
    return Producer({'bootstrap.servers': bs, 'log_level': 0,
                     'message.timeout.ms': 5000, **extra})


def send(bs, name, records):
    p = producer(bs)
    errors = []
    for part, value, timestamp in records:
        p.produce(name, partition=part, value=value, timestamp=timestamp,
                  on_delivery=lambda e,m: errors.append(e))
    assert p.flush(10) == 0
    assert len(errors) == len(records) and not any(errors), errors


def consumer(bs, group=None, **extra):
    return Consumer({'bootstrap.servers': bs, 'group.id': group or uuid.uuid4().hex,
                     'enable.auto.commit': False, 'auto.offset.reset': 'earliest',
                     'log_level': 0, **extra})


def read(c, name, partition=0, offset=0, count=1, timeout=8):
    c.assign([TopicPartition(name, partition, offset)])
    rows = []
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    while len(rows)<count and time.monotonic()<deadline:
        m = c.poll(.1)
        if m is not None:
            assert not m.error(), m.error()
            rows.append(m)
    return rows


def committed(bs, group, name, partitions):
    c = consumer(bs, group)
    try:
        return [x.offset for x in coordinator_retry(lambda:
            c.committed([TopicPartition(name,p) for p in partitions],timeout=2))]
    finally:
        c.close()


def set_offsets(bs, group, name, values):
    c = consumer(bs, group)
    try:
        coordinator_retry(lambda: c.commit(offsets=[TopicPartition(name,p,v)
            for p,v in enumerate(values)],asynchronous=False))
    finally:
        c.close()


def coordinator_retry(operation):
    """Retry only native coordinator discovery transitions, never semantic errors."""
    deadline = time.monotonic()+6
    while True:
        try:
            return operation()
        except KafkaException as exc:
            error = exc.args[0]
            if error.code() not in (14,15,16) or time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                raise
            print('NATIVE_COORDINATOR_REDISCOVERY:'+str(error.code()), flush=True)
            time.sleep(.08)


def traced(f):
    def invoke(*args, **kwargs):
        print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:'+f.__name__, flush=True)
        try:
            result = f(*args, **kwargs)
        except BaseException:
            print('STUDENT_OPERATION_RAISED:'+f.__name__, flush=True)
            raise
        print('STUDENT_OPERATION_RETURNED:'+f.__name__, flush=True)
        return result
    return invoke

"""Batch C only: real separated KRaft controllers and data brokers."""
from confluent_kafka import TopicCollection


def resource_event(row):
    path=Path.cwd()/'checks/native-c-resources.jsonl'
    path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with path.open('a') as stream:stream.write(json.dumps(row)+'\n')


class NativeCluster:
    def __init__(self, root, brokers, controllers, overrides=None, sasl=False):
        self.root=Path(root)
        self.home=Path(os.environ.get('OPSFORGE_KAFKA_HOME') or os.environ.get('KAFKA_HOME') or '/opt/kafka')
        self.java=Path(os.environ.get('JAVA_HOME') or '/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64')/'bin/java'
        assert (self.home/'libs/kafka_2.13-4.0.0.jar').is_file()
        self.broker_ids=list(range(1,brokers+1));self.controller_ids=list(range(101,101+controllers))
        used=set()
        def allocate():
            while True:
                number=port()
                if number not in used:used.add(number);return number
        self.controller_ports={n:allocate() for n in self.controller_ids}
        self.broker_ports={n:allocate() for n in self.broker_ids}
        self.sasl_ports={n:allocate() for n in self.broker_ids} if sasl else {}
        self.bootstrap=','.join(f'127.0.0.1:{self.broker_ports[n]}' for n in self.broker_ids)
        self.controller_bootstrap=','.join(f'127.0.0.1:{self.controller_ports[n]}' for n in self.controller_ids)
        self.sasl_bootstrap=','.join(f'127.0.0.1:{self.sasl_ports[n]}' for n in self.broker_ids) if sasl else None
        self.password='s02-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.processes={};self.logs={};self.configs={};self.commands={}
        voters=','.join(f'{n}@127.0.0.1:{self.controller_ports[n]}' for n in self.controller_ids)
        self.command=[str(self.java),'-Xms32m','-Xmx256m','-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1',
            '-Dlog4j2.configurationFile='+str(self.home/'config/log4j2.yaml'),
            '-Dkafka.logs.dir='+str(self.root/'java-logs'),'-cp',str(self.home/'libs/*')]
        self.cluster_id=base64.urlsafe_b64encode(uuid.uuid4().bytes).decode().rstrip('=')
        for n in self.controller_ids+self.broker_ids:
            controller=n in self.controller_ids
            node=self.root/str(n);node.mkdir()
            settings={'process.roles':'controller' if controller else 'broker','node.id':str(n),
                'controller.quorum.voters':voters,'controller.listener.names':'CONTROLLER',
                'listener.security.protocol.map':'PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT'+(',SASL_PLAINTEXT:SASL_PLAINTEXT' if sasl else ''),
                'inter.broker.listener.name':'PLAINTEXT','log.dirs':str(node/'data'),
                'num.partitions':'2','offsets.topic.replication.factor':str(min(brokers,3)),
                'offsets.topic.num.partitions':'1','transaction.state.log.replication.factor':str(min(brokers,3)),
                'transaction.state.log.min.isr':'1','transaction.state.log.num.partitions':'1',
                'group.initial.rebalance.delay.ms':'0','auto.create.topics.enable':'false',
                'num.network.threads':'2','num.io.threads':'2','replica.lag.time.max.ms':'2000',
                'replica.fetch.wait.max.ms':'100','replica.socket.timeout.ms':'3000',
                'log.retention.check.interval.ms':'200','log.segment.delete.delay.ms':'100',
                'log.retention.ms':'-1',
                'log.cleaner.dedupe.buffer.size':'16777216',
                'controlled.shutdown.enable':'true'}
            if controller:
                settings['listeners']=f'CONTROLLER://127.0.0.1:{self.controller_ports[n]}'
            else:
                settings['listeners']=f'PLAINTEXT://127.0.0.1:{self.broker_ports[n]}'
                if sasl:settings['listeners']+=f',SASL_PLAINTEXT://127.0.0.1:{self.sasl_ports[n]}'
                settings['advertised.listeners']=settings['listeners']
                settings.update(overrides or {})
            if sasl:
                settings.update({'authorizer.class.name':'org.apache.kafka.metadata.authorizer.StandardAuthorizer',
                    'super.users':'User:admin;User:ANONYMOUS','allow.everyone.if.no.acl.found':'false'})
                if not controller:
                    settings['sasl.enabled.mechanisms']='PLAIN'
                    settings['listener.name.sasl_plaintext.plain.sasl.jaas.config']=(
                        'org.apache.kafka.common.security.plain.PlainLoginModule required '
                        f'user_admin="{self.password}" user_reader="{self.password}";')
            conf=node/'server.properties';conf.write_text(''.join(f'{k}={v}\n' for k,v in settings.items()))
            self.configs[n]=conf
            p=subprocess.run(self.command+['kafka.tools.StorageTool','format','--cluster-id='+self.cluster_id,'-c',str(conf)],
                text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=20)
            assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
        (self.root/'client.properties').write_text('request.timeout.ms=2000\ndefault.api.timeout.ms=3000\n')
        (self.root/'cli-log4j2.xml').write_text('<Configuration status="ERROR"><Appenders><Console name="stderr" target="SYSTEM_ERR"><PatternLayout pattern="%m%n"/></Console></Appenders><Loggers><Root level="error"><AppenderRef ref="stderr"/></Root></Loggers></Configuration>')

    def start(self,n):
        assert n in self.configs and (n not in self.processes or self.processes[n].poll() is not None)
        log=open(self.root/str(n)/'server.log','a+')
        expected_parent=os.getpid()
        def guard():
            if ctypes.CDLL(None).prctl(1,signal.SIGKILL,0,0,0)!=0 or os.getppid()!=expected_parent:os._exit(125)
        cmd=self.command+['kafka.Kafka',str(self.configs[n])]
        p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=log,start_new_session=True,preexec_fn=guard)
        self.processes[n]=p;self.logs[n]=log
        ports=[self.controller_ports[n]] if n in self.controller_ids else [self.broker_ports[n]]+([self.sasl_ports[n]] if n in self.sasl_ports else [])
        manifest={'event':'start','pid':p.pid,'pgid':p.pid,'directory':str(self.root),
            'node_id':n,'ports':ports,'command':cmd}
        resource_event(manifest)
        print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_START:'+json.dumps({k:v for k,v in manifest.items() if k not in ('event','command')}),flush=True)

    def stop(self,n):
        p=self.processes[n]
        if p.poll() is None:
            os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
            try:p.wait(timeout=8)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);p.wait(timeout=5)
        self.logs[n].close()
        resource_event({'event':'process_reaped','pid':p.pid,'node_id':n})
        print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_PROCESS_REAPED:'+str(p.pid),flush=True)

    def ready(self, expected=None, timeout=35):
        expected=set(expected if expected is not None else self.broker_ids)
        a=AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0});deadline=time.monotonic()+timeout
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            for n,p in self.processes.items():
                if p.poll() is not None and n in expected:
                    raise AssertionError((self.root/str(n)/'server.log').read_text()[-6000:])
            try:
                md=a.list_topics(timeout=2)
                if expected<=set(md.brokers):return a
            except KafkaException as e:
                if e.args[0].code() not in (-195,-187,-185,-158,14,15,16):raise
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise AssertionError('native cluster readiness timeout: '+str(expected))

    def create(self,partitions=1,replicas=None,config=None,assignment=None):
        a=AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0});name='s02c-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
        spec=NewTopic(name,partitions,replicas or len(self.broker_ids),config=config or {}) if assignment is None else NewTopic(name,len(assignment),replica_assignment=assignment,config=config or {})
        a.create_topics([spec])[name].result(10)
        for part in range(len(assignment) if assignment else partitions):
            self.wait_isr(name,len(assignment[part]) if assignment else replicas or len(self.broker_ids),p=part)
        return name

    def partition(self,name,p=0):
        return AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0}).list_topics(name,timeout=3).topics[name].partitions[p]

    def wait_isr(self,name,count,p=0,timeout=15):
        deadline=time.monotonic()+timeout
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            try:
                md=self.partition(name,p)
                if md.leader>=0 and len(md.isrs)==count:return md
            except (KafkaException,KeyError):pass
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise AssertionError('ISR did not reach '+str(count))

    def cli(self,main,args,timeout=12):
        cmd=self.command+['-Dlog4j2.configurationFile='+str(self.root/'cli-log4j2.xml'),main,*args]
        result=subprocess.run(cmd,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout)
        print('NATIVE_CLI:'+json.dumps({'command':cmd,'rc':result.returncode,'output':result.stdout[-3500:],'stderr':result.stderr[-1500:]}),flush=True)
        return result

    def quorum_command(self):
        return self.command+['-Dlog4j2.configurationFile='+str(self.root/'cli-log4j2.xml'),'org.apache.kafka.tools.MetadataQuorumCommand','--bootstrap-controller',self.controller_bootstrap,
            '--command-config',str(self.root/'client.properties'),'describe','--status']


@contextlib.contextmanager
def cluster(brokers=3,controllers=1,overrides=None,sasl=False):
    d=None
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='session02-kafka-c-') as d:
            box=NativeCluster(d,brokers,controllers,overrides,sasl)
            try:
                for n in box.controller_ids+box.broker_ids:box.start(n)
                box.ready()
                print('NATIVE_KAFKA_4_CLUSTER_READY:'+json.dumps({'brokers':box.broker_ids,'controllers':box.controller_ids}),flush=True)
                yield box
            finally:
                for n in box.broker_ids+box.controller_ids:
                    if n in box.processes:box.stop(n)
    finally:
        if d is not None:
            assert not Path(d).exists()
            resource_event({'event':'directory_removed','directory':d})
            print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY_REMOVED:'+d,flush=True)

实现rename_plan(old,new,allowed,cutover_ns)和merge_history(streams)。allowed来自可信上游已认证授权集合；旧新租户必须不同且都获授权，拒绝越权；切换水位为非负整数ns，bool非法。返回新写租户new、读/规则租户[old,new]、水位、不自动迁移历史及回退写old。并存窗口必须读两个租户的完整查询区间，遗漏采集器可能仍向旧租户写切换后的事件。merge_history解析原生streams内JSON，以非空event_id去重，同ID异内容ValueError，返回按ID排序完整events及duplicates。交付transition.md覆盖规则/看板依赖、时间覆盖、混合客户端与回退，不能改头就宣称历史迁移。 MD首行按初始模板填写题定事实JSON，其后至少120字方案；程序仅校验结构/事实与代码，完整叙述由非作者独立语义复核，可由不同作者AI代理完成并记录reviewer类型，不要求人类签字。

# 租户更名切换合同

## 操作任务

import solution as task

 if not name.startswith('_') and inspect.isfunction(value) and value.__module__=='solution':setattr(task,name,traced(value))

 l=s.loki
 for app in ['late-normal','late-within','late-outside']:

  group=rule['group'];assert group['interval']=='1s' and group['rules'][0]['labels']=={'app':app,'severity':'critical'} and group['rules'][0]['for']=='0s'
  s.add_rules('fake',app+'.yml',[group])
 s.wait_notifier()
 wall=time.time();mono=time.monotonic();n=int(wall)*10**9
 for app,lag in [('late-normal',0),('late-within',2),('late-outside',10)]:l.push([{'stream':{'app':app},'values':[[str(n-lag*10**9),'ERROR delayed-event']]}])
 def firing_apps():return {alert['labels'].get('app') for alert in s.alerts() if alert['labels'].get('alertname')=='S02DelayedLogs'}
 eventually(lambda:{'late-normal','late-within'}<=firing_apps(),'normal and within-window native alerts',seconds=8)
 assert 'late-outside' not in firing_apps() and lines(l.logs('{app="late-outside"}',n-11*10**9,n))==['ERROR delayed-event']

 discovered=wall+(hooks[0]['monotonic']-mono)-(n/10**9-2);assert discovered<=7,'measured bound includes explicit 2-second scheduling tolerance'
 before={a['fingerprint'] for a in s.alerts() if a['labels'].get('app')=='late-within'}
 l.push([{'stream':{'app':'late-within'},'values':[[str(n-2*10**9),'ERROR delayed-event']]}]);time.sleep(.3)
 after={a['fingerprint'] for a in s.alerts() if a['labels'].get('app')=='late-within'};assert before==after

def ident():return 's02next-'+uuid.uuid4().hex

    body=''.join(json.dumps({'index':{'_index':name,'_id':id}})+'\n'+json.dumps(document)+'\n' for id,document in rows.items())

    name=ident();create(es,name,{'properties':{'term':{'type':'keyword'}}});rows={str(i):{'term':uuid.uuid4().hex} for i in range(128)};bulk(es,name,rows)

    try:
        for limit in ('16384b','1024b','64b'):

            if status==429 and _native_breaker(data.get('error',{})):refusal=data;break
        assert refusal is not None,'native request breaker capability unavailable; do not fabricate429'
    finally:ok(es.request('PUT','/_cluster/settings',{'transient':{'indices.breaker.request.limit':old}}))
    observations=[];previous=node
    for _ in range(3):
        try:
            ok(es.request('PUT','/_cluster/settings',{'transient':{'indices.breaker.request.limit':limit}}))
            status,data=es.request('POST','/'+name+'/_search',{'size':0,'aggs':{'terms':{'terms':{'field':'term','size':128}}}})
            assert status==429 and _native_breaker(data.get('error',{})),('actual repeated breaker refusal missing',status,data)
            observations.append({'status':status,'after_gc':False})
        finally:ok(es.request('PUT','/_cluster/settings',{'transient':{'indices.breaker.request.limit':old}}))
        status,data=es.request('POST','/'+name+'/_count',{'query':{'match_all':{}}});assert status==200 and data['count']==len(rows)
        owned_gc(es)
        def read_heap():return next(iter(ok(es.request('GET','/_nodes/_local/stats/jvm,breaker'))['nodes'].values()))
        fresh=wait_until(read_heap,lambda n:n['jvm']['timestamp']>previous['jvm']['timestamp'] and sum(v['collection_count'] for v in n['jvm']['gc']['collectors'].values())>sum(v['collection_count'] for v in previous['jvm']['gc']['collectors'].values()),6)
        observations.append({'status':status,'after_gc':True,'heap_used':fresh['jvm']['mem']['heap_used_in_bytes'],'timestamp':fresh['jvm']['timestamp']});previous=fresh

import pathlib,sys,json,time,uuid,copy,threading,hashlib,math

import solution as task
from elasticsearch_native import Elasticsearch,NativeCluster,ok,traced,wait_until,owned_gc,tool_home,event
from urllib.parse import quote
def ident():return 's02next-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
def create(es,name,mappings=None,settings=None):return ok(es.request('PUT','/'+name,{'settings':{'number_of_shards':1,'number_of_replicas':0,**(settings or {})},'mappings':mappings or {}}))
def put(es,name,id,body):return ok(es.request('PUT','/'+name+'/_doc/'+quote(id,safe='')+'?refresh=true',body))
def docs(es,name):return {h['_id']:h['_source'] for h in ok(es.request('POST','/'+name+'/_search',{'size':1000,'query':{'match_all':{}}}))['hits']['hits']}
def bulk(es,name,rows):
    body=''.join(json.dumps({'index':{'_index':name,'_id':id}})+'\n'+json.dumps(document)+'\n' for id,document in rows.items())
    result=ok(es.request('POST','/_bulk?refresh=true',body));assert not result['errors'],result
task.assess_heap=traced(task.assess_heap)
with Elasticsearch() as es:
    name=ident();create(es,name,{'properties':{'value':{'type':'keyword'},'payload':{'type':'keyword','index':False,'doc_values':False}}});bulk(es,name,{str(i):{'value':uuid.uuid4().hex} for i in range(256)})
    samples=[]
    for iteration in range(4):
        start=time.monotonic();ok(es.request('POST','/'+name+'/_search',{'size':0,'aggs':{'keys':{'terms':{'field':'value','size':128}}}}));latency=(time.monotonic()-start)*1000
        write_begin=time.monotonic();put(es,name,'probe-'+str(iteration),{'value':uuid.uuid4().hex});write_latency=(time.monotonic()-write_begin)*1000
        if iteration:owned_gc(es)
        def read_jvm():return next(iter(ok(es.request('GET','/_nodes/_local/stats/jvm'))['nodes'].values()))
        if iteration:
            gc_node=wait_until(read_jvm,lambda n:n['jvm']['timestamp']>samples[-1]['timestamp'] and sum(v['collection_count'] for v in n['jvm']['gc']['collectors'].values())>samples[-1]['gc_count'],6)
            # Genuine HTTP indexing/fetching allocates in the real owned JVM.
            # Keep old-pool and total-heap values from the SAME fresh response;
            # do not manufacture a pool difference by editing sample numbers.
            allocation_rows={f'gc-alloc-{iteration}-{i}':{'value':uuid.uuid4().hex,'payload':uuid.uuid4().hex*4096} for i in range(8)}
            began=time.monotonic();bulk(es,name,allocation_rows);write_latency+=(time.monotonic()-began)*1000
            began=time.monotonic();fetched=ok(es.request('POST','/'+name+'/_search',{'size':8,'query':{'ids':{'values':list(allocation_rows)}},'_source':['payload']}));latency+=(time.monotonic()-began)*1000
            assert len(fetched['hits']['hits'])==8 and all(len(h['_source']['payload'])==131072 for h in fetched['hits']['hits']),'real allocating fetch did not return actual indexed payloads'
            node=wait_until(read_jvm,lambda n:n['jvm']['timestamp']>gc_node['jvm']['timestamp'],6)
        else:node=read_jvm()
        j=node['jvm'];mem=j['mem'];gc=j['gc']['collectors']
        sample={'timestamp':j['timestamp'],'heap_used':mem['heap_used_in_bytes'],'heap_max':mem['heap_max_in_bytes'],'old_used':mem['pools']['old']['used_in_bytes'],'gc_count':sum(x['collection_count'] for x in gc.values()),'gc_ms':sum(x['collection_time_in_millis'] for x in gc.values()),'query_latency_ms':latency,'write_latency_ms':write_latency};samples.append(sample);time.sleep(.01)
    assert samples[-1]['gc_count']>samples[0]['gc_count'],'real after-GC capability did not produce collection evidence; no synthetic substitution'
    assert any(s['old_used']<s['heap_used'] for s in samples[1:]),'native JVM sample contrast unavailable: old pool equals total after GC/allocation; never credit indistinguishable substitution'
    print('NATIVE_REAL_AFTER_GC_POOL_SAMPLES:'+json.dumps(samples),flush=True)
    before=copy.deepcopy(samples);out=task.assess_heap(samples);assert samples==before
    assert out.get('peak_heap_bytes')==max(s['heap_used'] for s in samples)
    assert out.get('after_gc_old_bytes')==[s['old_used'] for s in samples[1:]] and out.get('after_gc_old_fraction')==[s['old_used']/s['heap_max'] for s in samples[1:]]
    assert out.get('gc_count_delta')==samples[-1]['gc_count']-samples[0]['gc_count'] and out.get('gc_time_delta_ms')==samples[-1]['gc_ms']-samples[0]['gc_ms']
    assert out.get('query_latency_ms')==[s['query_latency_ms'] for s in samples] and out.get('write_latency_ms')==[s['write_latency_ms'] for s in samples] and out.get('gc_observed') is True and out.get('leak_proven') is False and out.get('need_longer_retained_old_trend') is True and out.get('file_cache_tradeoff_acknowledged') is True
    try:task.assess_heap(samples[:1])
    except ValueError:pass
    else:raise AssertionError('one sample used as trend proof')

print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)

import json,time,math
from urllib.parse import quote
def _ok(reply):
    status,data=reply
    assert status in (200,201),(status,data)
    return data
def _part(value):return quote(value,safe='')
def _nodes(es):return _ok(es.request('GET','/_nodes/_local/stats/jvm,process,os,breaker'))['nodes']
from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction
def capacity_report(es,index,raw_bytes,daily_raw_bytes,days,replicas,headroom,repository,snapshot,repository_dir):
    if any(type(x) is not int or x<=0 for x in (raw_bytes,daily_raw_bytes,days)) or type(replicas) is not int or replicas<0 or not isinstance(headroom,(int,float)) or isinstance(headroom,bool) or not math.isfinite(headroom) or headroom<1:raise ValueError('positive measured bytes/days and explicit replica/headroom required')
    root=Path(repository_dir).resolve()
    if not root.is_relative_to((es.root/'repo').resolve()) or not root.is_dir():raise ValueError('owned actual repository directory required')
    stats=_ok(es.request('GET','/'+_part(index)+'/_stats/store'))['_all'];settings=_ok(es.request('GET','/'+_part(index)+'/_settings'))[index]['settings']['index']
    primary=stats['primaries']['store']['size_in_bytes'];total=stats['total']['store']['size_in_bytes']
    snapshot_data=_ok(es.request('GET','/_snapshot/'+_part(repository)+'/'+_part(snapshot)+'/_status'))['snapshots'][0]
    assert snapshot_data['state']=='SUCCESS';referenced=snapshot_data['stats']['total']['size_in_bytes']
    ratio=Fraction(primary,raw_bytes);planned=ratio*daily_raw_bytes*days*(replicas+1)*Fraction(str(headroom));live=(planned.numerator+planned.denominator-1)//planned.denominator
    physical=sum(p.stat().st_size for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink())
    return {'raw_bytes':raw_bytes,'primary_store_bytes':primary,'actual_total_store_bytes':total,'observed_replica_setting':int(settings['number_of_replicas']),'amplification':float(ratio),'planned_live_bytes':live,'snapshot_referenced_bytes':referenced,'repository_physical_bytes':physical,'snapshot_equals_second_live_replica':False,'production_coefficient_confirmed':False}

from elasticsearch_native import Elasticsearch,NativeCluster,ok,traced,wait_until,owned_gc,tool_home,event
from urllib.parse import quote
def ident():return 's02next-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
def create(es,name,mappings=None,settings=None):return ok(es.request('PUT','/'+name,{'settings':{'number_of_shards':1,'number_of_replicas':0,**(settings or {})},'mappings':mappings or {}}))
def put(es,name,id,body):return ok(es.request('PUT','/'+name+'/_doc/'+quote(id,safe='')+'?refresh=true',body))
def docs(es,name):return {h['_id']:h['_source'] for h in ok(es.request('POST','/'+name+'/_search',{'size':1000,'query':{'match_all':{}}}))['hits']['hits']}
def bulk(es,name,rows):
    body=''.join(json.dumps({'index':{'_index':name,'_id':id}})+'\n'+json.dumps(document)+'\n' for id,document in rows.items())
    result=ok(es.request('POST','/_bulk?refresh=true',body));assert not result['errors'],result
task.shard_cost_report=traced(task.shard_cost_report)
with Elasticsearch() as es:
    names={'few':ident(),'many':ident()};rows={str(i):{'message':'same-corpus '+uuid.uuid4().hex,'value':i} for i in range(120)}
    for layout,name in names.items():create(es,name,settings={'number_of_shards':1 if layout=='few' else 8});bulk(es,name,rows)
    trace=[];request=es.request
    def logged(method,path,body=None):
        reply=request(method,path,body);trace.append((method,path,copy.deepcopy(reply)));return reply
    es.request=logged
    def check_report(out):
        assert out.get('heap_causally_attributed_to_one_index') is False and out.get('production_relative_performance_proven') is False
        cpu=[n for m,p,r in trace if r[0]==200 and isinstance(r[1],dict) and 'nodes' in r[1] for n in r[1]['nodes'].values() if 'mem' in n.get('jvm',{})]
        assert any((out.get('shared_heap_used_bytes'),out.get('shared_heap_max_bytes'),out.get('heap_timestamp'))==(n['jvm']['mem']['heap_used_in_bytes'],n['jvm']['mem']['heap_max_in_bytes'],n['timestamp']) for n in cpu),'heap values not from native sample'
        for layout,name in names.items():
            result=out.get('layouts',{}).get(layout,{});assert result.get('index')==name and result.get('primary_shards')==(1 if layout=='few' else 8) and result.get('docs')==len(rows)
            native_stats=[r[1]['indices'][name]['primaries'] for m,p,r in trace if r[0]==200 and '/_stats/' in p and isinstance(r[1],dict) and name in r[1].get('indices',{})]
            assert any((result.get('primary_store_bytes'),result.get('segments'))==(s['store']['size_in_bytes'],s['segments']['count']) for s in native_stats),'store/segments report is not from actual same-index native stats'
            metadata=[r[1]['metadata']['indices'][name] for m,p,r in trace if r[0]==200 and isinstance(r[1],dict) and name in r[1].get('metadata',{}).get('indices',{})]
            assert metadata and result.get('metadata_serialized_bytes') in [len(json.dumps(s,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()) for s in metadata],'metadata byte proxy is not from actual canonical native response'
            recoveries=[r[1][name]['shards'] for m,p,r in trace if r[0]==200 and p.split('?')[0].endswith('/_recovery') and isinstance(r[1],dict) and name in r[1]]
            assert recoveries and any((result.get('recovery_total_ms'),result.get('recovery_max_ms'),result.get('all_recoveries_done'))==(sum(s['total_time_in_millis'] for s in rs),max((s['total_time_in_millis'] for s in rs),default=0),all(s['stage']=='DONE' for s in rs)) for rs in recoveries),'recovery report requires actual per-shard native observations (legitimate zero durations allowed)'
    owned_gc(es);trace.clear();before=task.shard_cost_report(es,names);check_report(before);assert all(x['ready'] for x in before['layouts'].values())
    es.restart();wait_until(lambda:ok(es.request('GET','/_cluster/health')),lambda h:h['status']=='green' and h['number_of_nodes']==1,20);owned_gc(es);trace.clear();after=task.shard_cost_report(es,names);check_report(after)

    ok(es.request('PUT','/'+names['many']+'/_settings',{'index.number_of_replicas':1}));wait_until(lambda:ok(es.request('GET','/_cluster/health/'+names['many'])),lambda h:h['status']=='yellow',10)

    ok(es.request('PUT','/'+names['many']+'/_settings',{'index.number_of_replicas':0}))
    print('NATIVE_SAME_CORPUS_SHARDS_RESTART_RECOVERY_AND_SHARED_HEAP:'+json.dumps({'before':before,'after':after}),flush=True)

import pathlib,sys,json,time,uuid,copy,threading,hashlib,math

import solution as task
from elasticsearch_native import Elasticsearch,NativeCluster,ok,traced,wait_until,owned_gc,tool_home,event
from urllib.parse import quote
def ident():return 's02next-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
def create(es,name,mappings=None,settings=None):return ok(es.request('PUT','/'+name,{'settings':{'number_of_shards':1,'number_of_replicas':0,**(settings or {})},'mappings':mappings or {}}))
def put(es,name,id,body):return ok(es.request('PUT','/'+name+'/_doc/'+quote(id,safe='')+'?refresh=true',body))

def bulk(es,name,rows):

task.install_entity_transform=traced(task.install_entity_transform)
task.rebuild_entity_transform=traced(task.rebuild_entity_transform)
with Elasticsearch(transform=True) as es:
    source,destination,job=ident(),ident(),ident();create(es,source,{'properties':{'event_id':{'type':'keyword'},'entity':{'type':'keyword'},'amount':{'type':'double'},'event_time':{'type':'date'},'updated_at':{'type':'date'}}},settings={'refresh_interval':'-1'})
    now=int(time.time()*1000);initial={'a1':{'event_id':'a1','entity':'A','amount':2,'event_time':now-10000000,'updated_at':now-10000},'a2':{'event_id':'a2','entity':'A','amount':3,'event_time':now-10000000,'updated_at':now-10000},'b1':{'event_id':'b1','entity':'B','amount':7,'event_time':now-10000000,'updated_at':now-10000}};bulk(es,source,initial)
    calls=[];request=es.request
    def logged(method,path,body=None):
        result=request(method,path,body);calls.append((method,path,copy.deepcopy(result)));return result
    es.request=logged
    def table():
        hits=ok(es.request('POST','/'+destination+'/_search',{'size':1000,'query':{'match_all':{}}}))['hits']['hits']
        assert len(hits)==len({h['_source']['entity'] for h in hits}),'duplicate entity rows hidden by dictionary overwrite'
        return {h['_source']['entity']:{'total':h['_source']['total'],'event_count':h['_source']['event_count']} for h in hits}
    def checkpoint():return ok(es.request('GET','/_transform/'+job+'/_stats'))['transforms'][0].get('checkpointing',{}).get('last',{}).get('checkpoint',0)
