        actual_schema=ok(es.request('GET','/'+destination+'/_mapping'))[destination]['mappings']['properties'];expected_schema={'entity':'keyword','total':'double','event_count':'long'}
        assert {key:actual_schema[key]['type'] for key in expected_schema}==expected_schema and out.get('destination_schema')==expected_schema
        assert out.get('source_event_key')=='_id=event_id' and out.get('privilege_plan_indices')=={'source':source,'destination':destination}
        privilege_plan=out.get('required_privileges');expected_privileges={'cluster':{'manage_transform'},'source_reader':{'read','view_index_metadata'},'destination_writer':{'read','create_index','index'}}
        assert isinstance(privilege_plan,dict) and all(isinstance(privilege_plan.get(key),list) for key in expected_privileges)
        assert {key:set(privilege_plan[key]) for key in expected_privileges}==expected_privileges
        maintenance=privilege_plan.get('maintenance_extra');assert isinstance(maintenance,dict) and set(maintenance.get('source',[]))==set(maintenance.get('destination',[]))=={'manage'}

        wait_until(table,lambda t:t=={'A':{'total':5,'event_count':2},'B':{'total':7,'event_count':1}},18);before=checkpoint()

        expected={'A':{'total':23,'event_count':2},'B':{'total':7,'event_count':1},'C':{'total':4,'event_count':1}}
        wait_until(table,lambda t:t==expected,18);wait_until(checkpoint,lambda c:c>before,10);last=checkpoint()
        put(es,source,'a2',{**initial['a2'],'entity':'E','updated_at':int(time.time()*1000)})

        observed=table();assert observed.get('A')==after_move.get('A') and observed.get('B')=={'total':7,'event_count':1} and observed.get('E')=={'total':3,'event_count':1},'native limitation control changed; review exact8.19.7 behavior'
        prior_source=docs(es,source)
        ok(es.request('PUT','/'+source+'/_doc/a1',{**initial['a1'],'amount':25}));ok(es.request('DELETE','/'+source+'/_doc/heartbeat'))
        assert ok(es.request('GET','/'+source+'/_doc/a1'))['_source']['amount']==25 and es.request('GET','/'+source+'/_doc/heartbeat')[0]==404

        rebuild_begin=len(calls);out=task.rebuild_entity_transform(es,source,destination,job);truth={'A':{'total':55,'event_count':2},'C':{'total':4,'event_count':1}}
        assert table()==truth and out.get('entity_count')==2 and out.get('full_rebuild_reconciled') is True and out.get('checkpoint',0)>=1 and out.get('source_delete_auto_propagates') is False and out.get('checkpoint_alone_is_correctness_proof') is False
        lifecycle=calls[rebuild_begin:];assert any(m=='POST' and '/_transform/'+job+'/_stop' in p and r[0]==200 for m,p,r in lifecycle) and any(m=='POST' and '/_transform/'+job+'/_start' in p and r[0]==200 for m,p,r in lifecycle),'actual transform stop/start lifecycle absent'
        assert ok(es.request('GET','/'+source+'/_settings?flat_settings=true'))[source]['settings'].get('index.blocks.write') in (None,'false')
        last=checkpoint();put(es,source,'after_restart',{'event_id':'after_restart','entity':'A','amount':1,'event_time':now-10000000,'updated_at':int(time.time()*1000)})
        continued={**truth,'A':{'total':56,'event_count':3}};wait_until(table,lambda t:t==continued,18);wait_until(checkpoint,lambda c:c>last,10)
        overflow={f'overflow-{i}':{'event_id':f'overflow-{i}','entity':f'overflow-{i}','amount':1,'event_time':now-100000000,'updated_at':now-100000000} for i in range(1001)};bulk(es,source,overflow)
        before_table=table();before_calls=len(calls)
        try:task.rebuild_entity_transform(es,source,destination,job)
        except ValueError:pass
        else:raise AssertionError('oversized full-rebuild input silently truncated')
        assert table()==before_table and not any(m=='DELETE' and p=='/'+destination or m=='POST' and '/_transform/'+job+'/' in p and any(x in p for x in ('/_stop','/_reset','/_start')) for m,p,r in calls[before_calls:]),'overflow rejection happened after destructive transform lifecycle'
        assert ok(es.request('GET','/'+source+'/_settings?flat_settings=true'))[source]['settings'].get('index.blocks.write') in (None,'false')
    finally:
        es.request('POST','/_transform/'+job+'/_stop?force=true&wait_for_completion=true&timeout=10s');es.request('DELETE','/_transform/'+job+'?force=true')

"""UNVERIFIED actual Nginx→Loki four-interface scenario, never run in preparation."""
import base64,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,secrets,subprocess,time,urllib.error,urllib.parse,urllib.request
import yaml
from native_c import Roles,Process,wait_for
from scenarios_c import NativeMinimumPending

class Gateway:
 def __init__(self,cluster,task):
  self.cluster=cluster;self.task=task;self.root=cluster.root/'gateway "quoted"\\s02';self.root.mkdir();self.port=cluster.port();self.service=None;self.events=[];self.passwords={name:secrets.token_urlsafe(20) for name in ['user_a','user_b']}
 def __enter__(self):
  self.users=self.root/'users';self.audit=self.root/'audit.log';self.pid=self.root/'nginx.pid'
  credentials=[]
  for name,password in self.passwords.items():
   salt=secrets.token_bytes(16);credentials.append(name+':{SSHA}'+base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha1(password.encode()+salt).digest()+salt).decode()+'\n')
  self.users.write_text(''.join(credentials))
  upstreams={name:'127.0.0.1:'+str(self.cluster.http[role]) for name,role in {'push':'distributor','query':'query-frontend','rules':'ruler','delete':'compactor'}.items()}
  config=self.task.gateway_config(str(self.users),str(self.audit),str(self.pid),self.port,upstreams);assert type(config) is str
  self.config=self.root/'nginx.conf';self.config.write_text(config)
  binary=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('NGINX_BINARY','/usr/sbin/nginx'))
  if not binary.is_file():raise NativeMinimumPending('actual Nginx binary missing; no substitute permitted')
  digest=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
  # Single native process mode is imposed by the trusted fixture, avoiding orphan
  # nginx workers when the checker parent dies. This is not a production topology.
  command=[str(binary),'-p',str(self.root)+'/', '-c',str(self.config),'-g','daemon off; master_process off;']
  test=subprocess.run(command+['-t'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=8)
  assert test.returncode==0,'actual Nginx rejected config: '+test.stdout[-1200:]
  print('NATIVE_C_NGINX_TOOL:'+json.dumps({'path':str(binary),'sha256':digest,'mode':'real native single process; not production throughput'}),flush=True)
  self.service=Process('nginx',self.root,command,[self.port]).start()
  try:wait_for(lambda:self.service.alive() and 200<=self.request('/loki/api/v1/query_range',identity=None)[0]<600,'actual Nginx HTTP readiness');return self
  except BaseException:self.__exit__(None,None,None);raise
 def request(self,path,identity='user_a',method='GET',body=None,forged=None,wrong_password=False,content_type='application/json'):
  headers={}
  if identity is not None:
   password='wrong-native-fixture-password' if wrong_password else self.passwords.get(identity,'unknown-native-user')
   headers['Authorization']='Basic '+base64.b64encode((identity+':'+password).encode()).decode()
  if forged is not None:headers['X-Scope-OrgID']=forged
  if body is not None:headers['Content-Type']=content_type
  data=body.encode() if type(body) is str else body
  req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.port)+path,data=data,headers=headers,method=method)
  started=time.monotonic()
  try:
   with urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({})).open(req,timeout=8) as response:status=response.status;answer=response.read().decode(errors='replace')
  except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:status=error.code;answer=error.read().decode(errors='replace');error.close()
  self.events.append({'path':path,'identity':identity,'method':method,'forged_tenant':forged,'wrong_password':wrong_password,'status':status,'response_body':answer,'request_body':body,'seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'at':time.time()})
  return status,answer

 def __exit__(self,*_):
  if self.service:self.service.stop()
  target=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('OPSF_C_ARTIFACT_DIR',str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks/native-c-artifacts')));target.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  out=target/('gateway-'+self.cluster.root.name+'.json');assert not out.exists()
  logs={name:(self.root/name).read_text(errors='replace') for name in ['audit.log','error.log','native.log','nginx.conf'] if (self.root/name).is_file()}
  out.write_text(json.dumps({'scope':'actual Nginx four API requests and responses; Authorization/password excluded','api_events':self.events,'logs':logs,'native_command':self.service.command if self.service else None,'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('NGINX_BINARY','/usr/sbin/nginx')).read_bytes()).hexdigest()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')


def gateway_query(gateway,n,identity,forged):
 path='/loki/api/v1/query_range?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'query':'{app="tenant-isolation"}','start':n-10,'end':n+100,'limit':100,'direction':'forward'})
 status,body=gateway.request(path,identity=identity,forged=forged);assert status==200,('native query gateway',status,body[:200]);response=json.loads(body);assert response['status']=='success'
 return sorted(value[1] for row in response['data']['result'] for value in row['values'])

def delete_list(gateway,identity,forged):
 status,body=gateway.request('/loki/api/v1/delete',identity=identity,forged=forged)
 assert status==200,'configured gateway failed the already-preflighted native delete list API: '+str(status)+body[:200]
 rows=json.loads(body)
 if not isinstance(rows,list):raise NativeMinimumPending('actual delete API response shape not yet supported: '+body[:300])
 return rows

def run_identity_case(task):
 # Mutable rules use the genuine pinned-source filesystem bucket candidate,
 # not the legacy local rule store (which cannot Set/Delete rule groups).
 retention={'limits_config':{'deletion_mode':'filter-and-delete','retention_period':'720h'},'compactor':{'delete_request_cancel_period':'5s','retention_delete_delay':'8s'}}
 with Roles(extra_roles=('ruler',),retention=retention,mutable_rules=True) as cluster:
  status,body=cluster.request('compactor','/loki/api/v1/delete',tenant='a',raw=True)
  if status!=200 or not isinstance(json.loads(body),list):raise NativeMinimumPending('actual baseline compactor API not available; no gateway grading outcome')
  with Gateway(cluster,task) as gateway:
   n=time.time_ns()-60*10**9;push_path='/loki/api/v1/push'
   for identity,owner,forged in [('user_a','a','b'),('user_b','b','a')]:
    body=json.dumps({'streams':[{'stream':{'app':'tenant-isolation'},'values':[[str(n),owner+'-confirmed']]}]})
    status,result=gateway.request(push_path,identity=identity,method='POST',body=body,forged=forged);assert status==204,('actual native push',status,result[:200])
   for tenant in ['a','b']:
    trusted_rows=cluster.query('{app="tenant-isolation"}',n-10,n+100,tenant=tenant)
    trusted_lines=sorted(value[1] for row in trusted_rows for value in row['values'])
    gateway.events.append({'scope':'trusted_internal_backend','interface':'write-query','tenant':tenant,'actual_lines':trusted_lines})
    assert trusted_lines==[tenant+'-confirmed'],'actual write ownership differs in trusted backend tenant '+tenant
   assert gateway_query(gateway,n,'user_a','b')==['a-confirmed'];assert gateway_query(gateway,n,'user_b','a')==['b-confirmed'];assert gateway_query(gateway,n,'user_a','a|b')==['a-confirmed']
   # Actual rule create/list/delete is exercised, not a synthetic local YAML list.
   for identity,owner,forged in [('user_a','a','b'),('user_b','b','a')]:
    group={'name':'owner-'+owner,'interval':'1s','rules':[{'record':'s02c:owner','expr':'vector(1)','labels':{'owner':owner}}]}
    status,result=gateway.request('/loki/api/v1/rules/shared',identity=identity,method='POST',body=yaml.safe_dump(group),forged=forged,content_type='application/yaml')
    if status not in (200,202,204):raise NativeMinimumPending('actual mutable Ruler API failed: '+str(status)+result[:300])
   for tenant in ['a','b']:
    native_status,native_rules=cluster.request('ruler','/loki/api/v1/rules/shared',tenant=tenant,raw=True)
    gateway.events.append({'scope':'trusted_internal_backend','interface':'rules','tenant':tenant,'status':native_status,'actual_rules':native_rules})
    other='b' if tenant=='a' else 'a'
    assert native_status==200 and 'owner-'+tenant in native_rules and 'owner-'+other not in native_rules,'actual rule ownership differs in trusted backend '+tenant
   a_rules=gateway.request('/loki/api/v1/rules/shared',identity='user_a',forged='b');b_rules=gateway.request('/loki/api/v1/rules/shared',identity='user_b',forged='a')
   assert a_rules[0]==200 and 'owner-a' in a_rules[1] and 'owner-b' not in a_rules[1]
   assert b_rules[0]==200 and 'owner-b' in b_rules[1] and 'owner-a' not in b_rules[1]
   gateway.request('/loki/api/v1/rules/shared/owner-b',identity='user_a',method='DELETE',forged='b')
   assert 'owner-b' in gateway.request('/loki/api/v1/rules/shared',identity='user_b',forged='a')[1],'cross-tenant rule delete changed B'
   status,_=gateway.request('/loki/api/v1/rules/shared/owner-a',identity='user_a',method='DELETE',forged='b');assert status in (200,202,204)
   assert 'owner-a' not in gateway.request('/loki/api/v1/rules/shared',identity='user_a',forged='b')[1]
   # Unauthorized and wrong-password controls for all four real interfaces.
   targets=[(push_path,'POST',json.dumps({'streams':[]}),'application/json'),('/loki/api/v1/query_range?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'query':'{app="tenant-isolation"}','start':n-10,'end':n+100}),'GET',None,'application/json'),('/loki/api/v1/rules/shared','POST',yaml.safe_dump({'name':'unauthorized','rules':[]}),'application/yaml'),('/loki/api/v1/delete?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'query':'{app="tenant-isolation"}','start':n-10,'end':n+100}),'POST',None,'application/json')]
   for path,method,body,content_type in targets:
    for identity,wrong in [(None,False),('user_a',True),('unknown',False)]:
     status,_=gateway.request(path,identity=identity,method=method,body=body,forged='b',wrong_password=wrong,content_type=content_type);assert status in (401,403),('native unauthorized interface not denied',path,status)
   for tenant in ['a','b']:
    trusted_rows=cluster.query('{app="tenant-isolation"}',n-10,n+100,tenant=tenant)
    trusted_lines=sorted(value[1] for row in trusted_rows for value in row['values'])
    gateway.events.append({'scope':'trusted_internal_backend','interface':'write-query','tenant':tenant,'actual_lines':trusted_lines})
    assert trusted_lines==[tenant+'-confirmed'],'actual write ownership differs in trusted backend tenant '+tenant
   assert gateway_query(gateway,n,'user_a','b')==['a-confirmed'];assert gateway_query(gateway,n,'user_b','a')==['b-confirmed']
   # Request ownership and cancellation are proved using the actual compactor.
   deletion_path='/loki/api/v1/delete?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'query':'{app="tenant-isolation"}','start':n//10**9-1,'end':n//10**9+1})
   status,result=gateway.request(deletion_path,identity='user_b',method='POST',forged='a')
   assert status in (200,202,204),'configured gateway failed native delete-create: '+str(status)+result[:200]
   b_requests=delete_list(gateway,'user_b','a');assert b_requests
   b_id=b_requests[-1]['request_id']
   actual_b_status,actual_b_body=cluster.request('compactor','/loki/api/v1/delete',tenant='b',raw=True)
   actual_a_status,actual_a_body=cluster.request('compactor','/loki/api/v1/delete',tenant='a',raw=True)
   gateway.events.append({'scope':'trusted_internal_backend','interface':'delete','a':{'status':actual_a_status,'response':actual_a_body},'b':{'status':actual_b_status,'response':actual_b_body}})
   assert actual_b_status==actual_a_status==200 and any(row['request_id']==b_id for row in json.loads(actual_b_body)) and json.loads(actual_a_body)==[],'actual deletion request ownership differs in trusted backend'
   a_before=delete_list(gateway,'user_a','b');assert not a_before
   cancel_path='/loki/api/v1/delete?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'request_id':b_id})
   gateway.request(cancel_path,identity='user_a',method='DELETE',forged='b')
   assert any(row['request_id']==b_id for row in delete_list(gateway,'user_b','a')),'cross-tenant delete-request cancellation changed B'
   status,_=gateway.request(cancel_path,identity='user_b',method='DELETE',forged='a');assert status in (200,202,204)
   assert all(row['request_id']!=b_id for row in delete_list(gateway,'user_b','a'))
   status,result=gateway.request(deletion_path,identity='user_a',method='POST',forged='b');assert status in (200,202,204),(status,result[:200])
   assert not delete_list(gateway,'user_b','a'),'A-created deletion escaped into B'
   # Pinned3.5.5 delete client caches lists for5min. This isolation test makes
   # a real cold querier restart; it does not certify default propagation SLO
   # or physical compactor reclamation. Gateway/auth configuration is unchanged.
   cluster.restart_role('querier',clear_cache=True)
   wait_for(lambda:gateway_query(gateway,n,'user_a','b')==[],'actual cold querier A deletion filtering',seconds=15)
   assert gateway_query(gateway,n,'user_b','a')==['b-confirmed'],'actual A delete affected B data'
   audit,parsed_audit=verify_native_audit_matrix(gateway)
   print('NATIVE_C_IDENTITY_MATRIX:'+json.dumps({'native_interfaces':['push','query','rules_create_list_delete','delete_create_list_cancel_cold_logical_filter'],'forged_header_overridden':True,'native_audit_sha256':hashlib.sha256(audit.encode()).hexdigest(),'b_data_preserved_after_a_delete':True,'credentials_in_evidence':False,'querier_cold_restart_to_reload_delete_list':True,'default_five_minute_delete_cache_refresh_proven':False,'physical_reclaim_proven':False}),flush=True)


def verify_native_audit_matrix(gateway):
 from collections import Counter
 expected=Counter()
 for event in gateway.events:
  if 'path' not in event:continue
  user=event['identity'] or '-';tenant={'user_a':'a','user_b':'b'}.get(user,'denied')
  uri=urllib.parse.unquote(urllib.parse.urlsplit(event['path']).path)
  expected[(user,tenant,event['method'],uri,event['status'])]+=1
 deadline=time.monotonic()+2;parsed=[];audit=''
 while True:
  audit=gateway.audit.read_text() if gateway.audit.is_file() else '';parsed=[];malformed=False
  for line in audit.splitlines():
   try:
    if line.startswith('{'):
     row=json.loads(line);fields=[row[key] for key in ['user','tenant','method','uri','status']]
    else:
     fields=line.split()
     if len(fields)!=5:raise ValueError('native audit fields')
    user,tenant,method,uri,status=fields
    if any(type(value) is not str for value in [user,tenant,method,uri]) or type(status) is bool:raise ValueError('native audit field types')
    status=int(status);uri=urllib.parse.unquote(urllib.parse.urlsplit(uri).path);parsed.append((user,tenant,method,uri,status))
   except (ValueError,TypeError,KeyError):malformed=True;break
  if not malformed and Counter(parsed)==expected:return audit,parsed
  if time.monotonic()>=deadline:break
  time.sleep(.05)
 assert not malformed and Counter(parsed)==expected,'native per-request audit user/forced-tenant/method/URI/status matrix differs; full raw audit/API preserved in sidecar'

# 查询超时分层诊断与恢复

保留原始LogQL、租户、时间范围、结果标识和真实组件PID。frontend summary.execTime是包含下游排队等阶段的墙钟时间，不是纯执行；summary.queueTime以秒记录，chunksDownloadTime原字段为纳秒。原生字段缺失必须阻塞，不能补零或将wall减去聚合queue伪造成纯执行。

本受控样本显式关闭parallelise_shardable_queries，避免默认计划器先发stats子查询而把该等待误记成主查询等待。先真实停止唯一querier，在scheduler上观察该租户正队列，再启动真实querier。回读全部4096条原始ID，并在这一新PID读取loki_logql_querystats_latency_seconds的limited/range/status200 count=1及sum，从独立执行器观测其执行时间；不混入stats子请求，不把frontend墙钟当此值。队列等待需大于独立engine执行，并占受控frontend墙钟至少一半，才作为此题的queue样本。

随后在同一PID实际运行JSON解析和line_format，核对4096条文本全文。通过精确同标签histogram的count增加1和sum差观测这一次engine执行；同时保留实际扫描字节、下载时间、队列时间和frontend墙钟。本案例据此选择扫描/解析路径。下载为0只能在真实字段存在且值为0时记录；这是内存/本地样本，不认证慢对象故障。根据真实wall生成的额外object_read数字分支只验函数边界，明确不算第三个原生慢对象实验。

排队主导时先查租户公平、队列和实际可用querier，再在保留隔离与上限的前提内调整并发/容量；本实验通过恢复原有querier容量让真实队列继续，而不增加总timeout掩盖问题。扫描主导时先收窄时间/标签范围，避免不必要的宽扫描或重复解析，保持查询ID/全文对账；不能仅凭一次快慢宣称生产优化。这里的1/2是受控分类合同，不是对所有复杂分片查询的通用因果定律。

回退只恢复本检查的原有私有角色和配置，退出时回收自有进程、端口、缓存及目录，保存完整命令/PID birth/原生日志与失败。未更改默认身份/PATH，也未部署生产网关。生产采用前还需不同作者独立语义复核与实际平台入口/资源预算核验，可由不同作者AI记录reviewer类型，不要求人类签字。

实际测量合同要求有限非负数；bool、NaN、正负无穷均拒绝，原生缺失仍阻塞而非补零。

title: unclean leader election提高可用性可能牺牲什么？
answer: 从ISR外副本选主可能缺少已确认记录，导致数据丢失或日志截断。必须依据业务RPO显式决策；验收故障恢复的数据水位，不把能写入等同无损恢复。

import pathlib,sys,json,time,uuid,tempfile,os,subprocess,signal,math,socket,hashlib
sys.path[:0]=[str(pathlib.Path.cwd()),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks')]
from native import *
import solution as task
for n in list(vars(task)):
 f=getattr(task,n)
 if callable(f) and getattr(f,'__module__',None)=='solution' and not n.startswith('_'):setattr(task,n,traced(f))
with cluster(3,1) as box:
    a=AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':box.bootstrap,'log_level':0})
    name=box.create(config={'min.insync.replicas':'2','unclean.leader.election.enable':'false'})
    before=topic_uuid(a,name);base=uuid.uuid4().bytes;acked=uuid.uuid4().bytes
    send(box.bootstrap,name,[(0,base,int(time.time()*1000))]);box.wait_isr(name,3)
    box.stop(3);box.wait_isr(name,2)
    send(box.bootstrap,name,[(0,acked,int(time.time()*1000))])
    leader=box.partition(name).leader;assert leader in [1,2]
    box.stop(1);box.stop(2);box.start(3);a=box.ready(expected=[3])
    wait_until(lambda:box.partition(name).leader<0,20)
    refused=task.recover(a,name,False)
    assert refused['available'] is False and refused['unclean_enabled'] is False
    assert configs(a,ResourceType.TOPIC,name)['unclean.leader.election.enable'].value=='false'
    assert topic_uuid(a,name)==before
    for invalid in [1,'yes',None]:
        try:task.recover(a,name,invalid)
        except ValueError:pass
        else:raise AssertionError('RPO authorization must be explicit bool')
    accepted=task.recover(a,name,True);assert accepted['available'] and accepted['leader']==3
    native_before={k:(v.value,ConfigSource(v.source).name) for k,v in configs(a,ResourceType.TOPIC,name).items()}
    preserved=task.recover(a,name,False);assert preserved['unclean_enabled'] is True and preserved['available'] is True,'readonly mode must report an already enabled native flag truthfully'
    assert {k:(v.value,ConfigSource(v.source).name) for k,v in configs(a,ResourceType.TOPIC,name).items()}==native_before,'readonly False changed actual topic configuration'
    messages=collect(box.bootstrap,name,1,1)
    assert [m.value() for m in messages]==[base]
    c=consumer(box.bootstrap)
    try:assert c.get_watermark_offsets(TopicPartition(name,0),timeout=4)[1]==1
    finally:c.close()
    assert acked not in [m.value() for m in messages] and topic_uuid(a,name)==before
    print('NATIVE_UNCLEAN_RECOVERS_STALE_REPLICA_AND_LOSES_PREVIOUSLY_ACKNOWLEDGED_RECORD',flush=True)

print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)

def broker():
    home = Path(os.environ.get('OPSFORGE_KAFKA_HOME', '/opt/kafka'))

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='session02-kafka-') as d:

        conf = root / 'server.properties'

            f'log.dirs={root}/data', 'num.partitions=2',

        cmd = [str(java), '-Xms64m', '-Xmx256m', '-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1',
               '-Dlog4j2.configurationFile=' + str(home/'config/log4j2.yaml'),
               '-cp', str(home/'libs/*')]
        formatted = subprocess.run(cmd + ['kafka.tools.StorageTool', 'format',
            '--cluster-id=' + base64.urlsafe_b64encode(uuid.uuid4().bytes).decode().rstrip('='),
            '-c', str(conf)], text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
        assert formatted.returncode == 0, formatted.stdout + formatted.stderr
        with (root/'broker.log').open('w+') as log:
            expected_parent = os.getpid()
            def parent_guard():
                if ctypes.CDLL(None).prctl(1, signal.SIGTERM, 0, 0, 0) != 0:
                    os._exit(125)
                if os.getppid() != expected_parent:
                    os._exit(125)
            p = subprocess.Popen(cmd + ['kafka.Kafka', str(conf)], stdout=log, stderr=log,

            manifest = {'pid': p.pid, 'pgid': p.pid, 'directory': str(root),
                        'ports': [a,b], 'command': cmd + ['kafka.Kafka', str(conf)]}
            print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_START:' + json.dumps(manifest), flush=True)
            try:
                deadline = time.monotonic()+35

                    try:
                        with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1', a), timeout=.2):
                            break

                        time.sleep(.1)
                admin = AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers': bootstrap, 'log_level': 0})
                metadata_deadline = time.monotonic()+15

        assert not any(path.name == 'core' for path in root.iterdir())
    assert not root.exists()
    print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY_REMOVED:'+str(root), flush=True)


def topic(bs, count=2, config=None):
    name = 's02-' + uuid.uuid4().hex
    a = AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers': bs, 'log_level': 0})
    a.create_topics([NewTopic(name, count, 1, config=config or {})])[name].result(10)
    return name


def producer(bs, **extra):
    return Producer({'bootstrap.servers': bs, 'log_level': 0,
                     'message.timeout.ms': 5000, **extra})


def send(bs, name, records):
    p = producer(bs)
    errors = []
    for part, value, timestamp in records:
        p.produce(name, partition=part, value=value, timestamp=timestamp,
                  on_delivery=lambda e,m: errors.append(e))
    assert p.flush(10) == 0
    assert len(errors) == len(records) and not any(errors), errors


def consumer(bs, group=None, **extra):
    return Consumer({'bootstrap.servers': bs, 'group.id': group or uuid.uuid4().hex,
                     'enable.auto.commit': False, 'auto.offset.reset': 'earliest',
                     'log_level': 0, **extra})


def read(c, name, partition=0, offset=0, count=1, timeout=8):
    c.assign([TopicPartition(name, partition, offset)])
    rows = []
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    while len(rows)<count and time.monotonic()<deadline:
        m = c.poll(.1)
        if m is not None:
            assert not m.error(), m.error()
            rows.append(m)
    return rows


def committed(bs, group, name, partitions):
    c = consumer(bs, group)
    try:
        return [x.offset for x in coordinator_retry(lambda:
            c.committed([TopicPartition(name,p) for p in partitions],timeout=2))]
    finally:
        c.close()


def set_offsets(bs, group, name, values):
    c = consumer(bs, group)
    try:
        coordinator_retry(lambda: c.commit(offsets=[TopicPartition(name,p,v)
            for p,v in enumerate(values)],asynchronous=False))
    finally:
        c.close()


def coordinator_retry(operation):
    """Retry only native coordinator discovery transitions, never semantic errors."""
    deadline = time.monotonic()+6
    while True:
        try:
            return operation()
        except KafkaException as exc:
            error = exc.args[0]
            if error.code() not in (14,15,16) or time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                raise
            print('NATIVE_COORDINATOR_REDISCOVERY:'+str(error.code()), flush=True)
            time.sleep(.08)


def traced(f):
    def invoke(*args, **kwargs):
        print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:'+f.__name__, flush=True)
        try:
            result = f(*args, **kwargs)
        except BaseException:
            print('STUDENT_OPERATION_RAISED:'+f.__name__, flush=True)
            raise
        print('STUDENT_OPERATION_RETURNED:'+f.__name__, flush=True)
        return result
    return invoke

        except (OSError,IndexError):row['birth']=None
    path=Path.cwd()/'checks/native-d-resources.jsonl'
    path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with path.open('a') as stream:stream.write(json.dumps(row)+'\n')


class NativeCluster:
    def __init__(self, root, brokers, controllers, overrides=None, sasl=False):
        self.root=Path(root)
        self.home=Path(os.environ.get('OPSFORGE_KAFKA_HOME') or os.environ.get('KAFKA_HOME') or '/opt/kafka')
        self.java=Path(os.environ.get('JAVA_HOME') or '/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64')/'bin/java'
        assert (self.home/'libs/kafka_2.13-4.0.0.jar').is_file()
        self.broker_ids=list(range(1,brokers+1));self.controller_ids=list(range(101,101+controllers))
        used=set()
        def allocate():
            while True:
                number=port()
                if number not in used:used.add(number);return number
        self.controller_ports={n:allocate() for n in self.controller_ids}
        self.broker_ports={n:allocate() for n in self.broker_ids}
        self.sasl_ports={n:allocate() for n in self.broker_ids} if sasl else {}
        self.bootstrap=','.join(f'127.0.0.1:{self.broker_ports[n]}' for n in self.broker_ids)
        self.controller_bootstrap=','.join(f'127.0.0.1:{self.controller_ports[n]}' for n in self.controller_ids)
        self.sasl_bootstrap=','.join(f'127.0.0.1:{self.sasl_ports[n]}' for n in self.broker_ids) if sasl else None
        self.password='s02-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.processes={};self.logs={};self.configs={};self.commands={}
        voters=','.join(f'{n}@127.0.0.1:{self.controller_ports[n]}' for n in self.controller_ids)
        (self.root/'java-tmp').mkdir()
        self.command=[str(self.java),'-XX:-UsePerfData','-Djava.io.tmpdir='+str(self.root/'java-tmp'),'-Xms32m','-Xmx256m','-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1',
            '-Dlog4j2.configurationFile='+str(self.home/'config/log4j2.yaml'),
            '-Dkafka.logs.dir='+str(self.root/'java-logs'),'-cp',str(self.home/'libs/*')]
        self.cluster_id=base64.urlsafe_b64encode(uuid.uuid4().bytes).decode().rstrip('=')
        for n in self.controller_ids+self.broker_ids:
            controller=n in self.controller_ids
            node=self.root/str(n);node.mkdir()
            settings={'process.roles':'controller' if controller else 'broker','node.id':str(n),
                'controller.quorum.voters':voters,'controller.listener.names':'CONTROLLER',
                'listener.security.protocol.map':'PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT'+(',SASL_PLAINTEXT:SASL_PLAINTEXT' if sasl else ''),
                'inter.broker.listener.name':'PLAINTEXT','log.dirs':str(node/'data'),
                'num.partitions':'2','offsets.topic.replication.factor':str(min(brokers,3)),
                'offsets.topic.num.partitions':'1','transaction.state.log.replication.factor':str(min(brokers,3)),
                'transaction.state.log.min.isr':'1','transaction.state.log.num.partitions':'1',
                'group.initial.rebalance.delay.ms':'0','auto.create.topics.enable':'false',
                'num.network.threads':'2','num.io.threads':'2','replica.lag.time.max.ms':'2000',
                'replica.fetch.wait.max.ms':'100','replica.socket.timeout.ms':'3000',
                'log.retention.check.interval.ms':'200','log.segment.delete.delay.ms':'100',
                'log.retention.ms':'-1',
                'log.cleaner.dedupe.buffer.size':'16777216',
                'controlled.shutdown.enable':'true'}
            if controller:
                settings['listeners']=f'CONTROLLER://127.0.0.1:{self.controller_ports[n]}'
            else:
                settings['listeners']=f'PLAINTEXT://127.0.0.1:{self.broker_ports[n]}'
                if sasl:settings['listeners']+=f',SASL_PLAINTEXT://127.0.0.1:{self.sasl_ports[n]}'
                settings['advertised.listeners']=settings['listeners']
                settings.update(overrides or {})
            if sasl:
                settings.update({'authorizer.class.name':'org.apache.kafka.metadata.authorizer.StandardAuthorizer',
                    'super.users':'User:admin;User:ANONYMOUS','allow.everyone.if.no.acl.found':'false'})
                if not controller:
                    settings['sasl.enabled.mechanisms']='PLAIN'
                    settings['listener.name.sasl_plaintext.plain.sasl.jaas.config']=(
                        'org.apache.kafka.common.security.plain.PlainLoginModule required '
                        f'user_admin="{self.password}" user_reader="{self.password}" user_alice="{self.password}" user_bob="{self.password}";')
            conf=node/'server.properties';conf.write_text(''.join(f'{k}={v}\n' for k,v in settings.items()))
            resource_event({'event':'configuration','node_id':n,'path':str(conf),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(conf.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'redacted_settings':{k:('[ephemeral JAAS redacted]' if k.endswith('sasl.jaas.config') else v) for k,v in settings.items()}})
            self.configs[n]=conf
            p=subprocess.run(self.command+['kafka.tools.StorageTool','format','--cluster-id='+self.cluster_id,'-c',str(conf)],
                text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=20)
            resource_event({'event':'storage_format','command':p.args,'returncode':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr})
            assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
        (self.root/'client.properties').write_text('request.timeout.ms=2000\ndefault.api.timeout.ms=3000\n')
        (self.root/'cli-log4j2.xml').write_text('<Configuration status="ERROR"><Appenders><Console name="stderr" target="SYSTEM_ERR"><PatternLayout pattern="%m%n"/></Console></Appenders><Loggers><Root level="error"><AppenderRef ref="stderr"/></Root></Loggers></Configuration>')

    def start(self,n):
        assert n in self.configs and (n not in self.processes or self.processes[n].poll() is not None)
        log=open(self.root/str(n)/'server.log','a+')
        expected_parent=os.getpid()
        def guard():
            if ctypes.CDLL(None).prctl(1,signal.SIGKILL,0,0,0)!=0 or os.getppid()!=expected_parent:os._exit(125)
        cmd=self.command+['kafka.Kafka',str(self.configs[n])]
        p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=log,start_new_session=True,preexec_fn=guard)
        self.processes[n]=p;self.logs[n]=log
        ports=[self.controller_ports[n]] if n in self.controller_ids else [self.broker_ports[n]]+([self.sasl_ports[n]] if n in self.sasl_ports else [])
        manifest={'event':'start','pid':p.pid,'pgid':p.pid,'directory':str(self.root),
            'node_id':n,'ports':ports,'command':cmd}
        resource_event(manifest)
        print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_START:'+json.dumps({k:v for k,v in manifest.items() if k not in ('event','command')}),flush=True)

    def stop(self,n):
        p=self.processes[n]
        if p.poll() is None:
            os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
            try:p.wait(timeout=8)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);p.wait(timeout=5)
        self.logs[n].close()
        resource_event({'event':'process_reaped','pid':p.pid,'node_id':n})
        print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_PROCESS_REAPED:'+str(p.pid),flush=True)

    def ready(self, expected=None, timeout=35):
        expected=set(expected if expected is not None else self.broker_ids)
        a=AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0});deadline=time.monotonic()+timeout
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            for n,p in self.processes.items():
                if p.poll() is not None and n in expected:
                    raise AssertionError((self.root/str(n)/'server.log').read_text()[-6000:])
            try:
                md=a.list_topics(timeout=2)
                if expected<=set(md.brokers):return a
            except KafkaException as e:
                if e.args[0].code() not in (-195,-187,-185,-158,14,15,16):raise
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise AssertionError('native cluster readiness timeout: '+str(expected))

    def create(self,partitions=1,replicas=None,config=None,assignment=None):
        a=AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0});name='s02c-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
        spec=NewTopic(name,partitions,replicas or len(self.broker_ids),config=config or {}) if assignment is None else NewTopic(name,len(assignment),replica_assignment=assignment,config=config or {})
        a.create_topics([spec])[name].result(10)
        for part in range(len(assignment) if assignment else partitions):
            self.wait_isr(name,len(assignment[part]) if assignment else replicas or len(self.broker_ids),p=part)
        return name

    def partition(self,name,p=0):
        return AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0}).list_topics(name,timeout=3).topics[name].partitions[p]

    def wait_isr(self,name,count,p=0,timeout=15):
        deadline=time.monotonic()+timeout
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            try:
                md=self.partition(name,p)
                if md.leader>=0 and len(md.isrs)==count:return md
            except (KafkaException,KeyError):pass
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise AssertionError('ISR did not reach '+str(count))

    def cli(self,main,args,timeout=12):
        cmd=self.command+['-Dlog4j2.configurationFile='+str(self.root/'cli-log4j2.xml'),main,*args]
        result=subprocess.run(cmd,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout)
        print('NATIVE_CLI:'+json.dumps({'command':cmd,'rc':result.returncode,'output':result.stdout[-3500:],'stderr':result.stderr[-1500:]}),flush=True)
        return result

    def quorum_command(self):
        return self.command+['-Dlog4j2.configurationFile='+str(self.root/'cli-log4j2.xml'),'org.apache.kafka.tools.MetadataQuorumCommand','--bootstrap-controller',self.controller_bootstrap,
            '--command-config',str(self.root/'client.properties'),'describe','--status']


@contextlib.contextmanager
def cluster(brokers=3,controllers=1,overrides=None,sasl=False):
    d=None
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='session02-kafka-d-') as d:
            box=NativeCluster(d,brokers,controllers,overrides,sasl)
            try:
                for n in box.controller_ids+box.broker_ids:box.start(n)
                box.ready()
                print('NATIVE_KAFKA_4_CLUSTER_READY:'+json.dumps({'brokers':box.broker_ids,'controllers':box.controller_ids}),flush=True)
                yield box
            finally:
                try:
                    for n in box.broker_ids+box.controller_ids:
                        if n in box.processes:box.stop(n)
                finally:
                    for path in sorted(box.root.rglob('*')):
                        if path.is_file() and (path.name in ('server.log','streams-native.log') or box.root/'java-logs' in path.parents):
                            raw=path.read_bytes();resource_event({'event':'full_native_log','path':str(path),'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'base64':base64.b64encode(raw).decode()})
    finally:
        if d is not None:
            assert not Path(d).exists()
            resource_event({'event':'directory_removed','directory':d})
            print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY_REMOVED:'+d,flush=True)

_original_trace=traced
def traced(function):
    original=_original_trace(function)
    def call(*args,**kwargs):
        resource_event({'event':'student_operation_entered','function':function.__name__})
        expected=subprocess.run
        try:return original(*args,**kwargs)
        finally:
            if subprocess.run is not expected:
                subprocess.run=expected
                raise AssertionError('native CLI transport was replaced')
    return call

"""Trusted fixture: actual Kafka 4.0.0, private loopback process and directory."""
import base64
import contextlib
import ctypes
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import socket
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import uuid
from confluent_kafka import Consumer, Producer, TopicPartition, KafkaException
from confluent_kafka.admin import AdminClient, NewTopic


def port():
    with socket.socket() as s:
        s.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return s.getsockname()[1]


@contextlib.contextmanager
def broker():
    home = Path(os.environ.get('OPSFORGE_KAFKA_HOME', '/opt/kafka'))
    java = Path(os.environ.get('JAVA_HOME', '/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64')) / 'bin/java'
    assert (home / 'libs/kafka_2.13-4.0.0.jar').is_file(), 'actual Kafka 4.0.0 required'
    assert java.is_file(), 'explicit Java runtime required'
    version = subprocess.run([str(java), '-version'], text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=5)
    assert version.returncode == 0 and '64-Bit' in version.stderr, version.stderr
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='session02-kafka-') as d:
        root = Path(d)
        a, b = port(), port()
        while a == b:
            b = port()
        bootstrap = f'127.0.0.1:{a}'
        conf = root / 'server.properties'
        conf.write_text('\n'.join([
            'process.roles=broker,controller', 'node.id=1',
            f'controller.quorum.voters=1@127.0.0.1:{b}',
            f'listeners=PLAINTEXT://{bootstrap},CONTROLLER://127.0.0.1:{b}',
            f'advertised.listeners=PLAINTEXT://{bootstrap}',
            'listener.security.protocol.map=PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT',
            'controller.listener.names=CONTROLLER', 'inter.broker.listener.name=PLAINTEXT',
            f'log.dirs={root}/data', 'num.partitions=2',
            'offsets.topic.replication.factor=1', 'offsets.topic.num.partitions=1',
            'transaction.state.log.replication.factor=1', 'transaction.state.log.min.isr=1',
            'transaction.state.log.num.partitions=1', 'group.initial.rebalance.delay.ms=0',
            'auto.create.topics.enable=false', 'num.network.threads=2', 'num.io.threads=2',
            'transaction.abort.timed.out.transaction.cleanup.interval.ms=200',
        ]) + '\n')
        cmd = [str(java), '-Xms64m', '-Xmx256m', '-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1',
               '-Dlog4j2.configurationFile=' + str(home/'config/log4j2.yaml'),
               '-cp', str(home/'libs/*')]
        formatted = subprocess.run(cmd + ['kafka.tools.StorageTool', 'format',
            '--cluster-id=' + base64.urlsafe_b64encode(uuid.uuid4().bytes).decode().rstrip('='),
            '-c', str(conf)], text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
        assert formatted.returncode == 0, formatted.stdout + formatted.stderr
        with (root/'broker.log').open('w+') as log:
            expected_parent = os.getpid()
            def parent_guard():
                if ctypes.CDLL(None).prctl(1, signal.SIGTERM, 0, 0, 0) != 0:
                    os._exit(125)
                if os.getppid() != expected_parent:
                    os._exit(125)
            p = subprocess.Popen(cmd + ['kafka.Kafka', str(conf)], stdout=log, stderr=log,
                                 start_new_session=True, preexec_fn=parent_guard)
            manifest = {'pid': p.pid, 'pgid': p.pid, 'directory': str(root),
                        'ports': [a,b], 'command': cmd + ['kafka.Kafka', str(conf)]}
            print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_START:' + json.dumps(manifest), flush=True)
            try:
                deadline = time.monotonic()+35
                while True:
                    if p.poll() is not None:
                        log.seek(0)
                        raise AssertionError(log.read()[-6000:])
                    try:
                        with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1', a), timeout=.2):
                            break
                    except OSError:
                        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                            log.seek(0)
                            raise AssertionError('broker startup timeout: '+log.read()[-6000:])
                        time.sleep(.1)
                admin = AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers': bootstrap, 'log_level': 0})
                metadata_deadline = time.monotonic()+15
                while True:
                    try:
                        if admin.list_topics(timeout=2).brokers:
                            break
                    except KafkaException as exc:
                        code = exc.args[0].code()
                        if code not in (-195,-187,-185,14,15,16):
                            raise
                        print('NATIVE_METADATA_READINESS_RETRY:'+str(code), flush=True)
                    if time.monotonic() >= metadata_deadline:
                        raise AssertionError('native metadata readiness timeout')
                    if p.poll() is not None:
                        log.seek(0)
                        raise AssertionError('broker exited: '+log.read()[-3000:])
                    time.sleep(.08)
                print('NATIVE_KAFKA_4_READY:'+bootstrap, flush=True)
                yield bootstrap
            finally:
                if p.poll() is None:
                    os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                    try:
                        p.wait(timeout=10)
                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                        os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                        p.wait(timeout=5)
                assert p.poll() is not None
                print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_PROCESS_REAPED:'+str(p.pid), flush=True)
        assert not any(path.name == 'core' for path in root.iterdir())
    assert not root.exists()
    print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY_REMOVED:'+str(root), flush=True)


def topic(bs, count=2, config=None):
    name = 's02-' + uuid.uuid4().hex
    a = AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers': bs, 'log_level': 0})
    a.create_topics([NewTopic(name, count, 1, config=config or {})])[name].result(10)
    return name


def producer(bs, **extra):
    return Producer({'bootstrap.servers': bs, 'log_level': 0,
                     'message.timeout.ms': 5000, **extra})


def send(bs, name, records):
    p = producer(bs)
    errors = []
    for part, value, timestamp in records:
        p.produce(name, partition=part, value=value, timestamp=timestamp,
                  on_delivery=lambda e,m: errors.append(e))
    assert p.flush(10) == 0
    assert len(errors) == len(records) and not any(errors), errors


def consumer(bs, group=None, **extra):
    return Consumer({'bootstrap.servers': bs, 'group.id': group or uuid.uuid4().hex,
                     'enable.auto.commit': False, 'auto.offset.reset': 'earliest',
                     'log_level': 0, **extra})


def read(c, name, partition=0, offset=0, count=1, timeout=8):
    c.assign([TopicPartition(name, partition, offset)])
    rows = []
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    while len(rows)<count and time.monotonic()<deadline:
        m = c.poll(.1)
        if m is not None:
            assert not m.error(), m.error()
            rows.append(m)
    return rows


def committed(bs, group, name, partitions):
    c = consumer(bs, group)
    try:
        return [x.offset for x in coordinator_retry(lambda:
            c.committed([TopicPartition(name,p) for p in partitions],timeout=2))]
    finally:
        c.close()


def set_offsets(bs, group, name, values):
    c = consumer(bs, group)
    try:
        coordinator_retry(lambda: c.commit(offsets=[TopicPartition(name,p,v)
            for p,v in enumerate(values)],asynchronous=False))
    finally:
        c.close()


def coordinator_retry(operation):
    """Retry only native coordinator discovery transitions, never semantic errors."""
    deadline = time.monotonic()+6
    while True:
        try:
            return operation()
        except KafkaException as exc:
            error = exc.args[0]
            if error.code() not in (14,15,16) or time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                raise
            print('NATIVE_COORDINATOR_REDISCOVERY:'+str(error.code()), flush=True)
            time.sleep(.08)


def traced(f):
    def invoke(*args, **kwargs):
        print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:'+f.__name__, flush=True)
        try:
            result = f(*args, **kwargs)
        except BaseException:
            print('STUDENT_OPERATION_RAISED:'+f.__name__, flush=True)
            raise
        print('STUDENT_OPERATION_RETURNED:'+f.__name__, flush=True)
        return result
    return invoke

"""Batch C only: real separated KRaft controllers and data brokers."""
from confluent_kafka import TopicCollection


def resource_event(row):
    row=dict(row)
    if row.get('event')=='start' and row.get('pid'):
        try:row['birth']=Path('/proc',str(row['pid']),'stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()[19]
        except (OSError,IndexError):row['birth']=None
    path=Path.cwd()/'checks/native-d-resources.jsonl'
    path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with path.open('a') as stream:stream.write(json.dumps(row)+'\n')


class NativeCluster:
    def __init__(self, root, brokers, controllers, overrides=None, sasl=False):
        self.root=Path(root)
        self.home=Path(os.environ.get('OPSFORGE_KAFKA_HOME') or os.environ.get('KAFKA_HOME') or '/opt/kafka')
        self.java=Path(os.environ.get('JAVA_HOME') or '/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64')/'bin/java'
        assert (self.home/'libs/kafka_2.13-4.0.0.jar').is_file()
        self.broker_ids=list(range(1,brokers+1));self.controller_ids=list(range(101,101+controllers))
        used=set()
        def allocate():
            while True:
                number=port()
                if number not in used:used.add(number);return number
        self.controller_ports={n:allocate() for n in self.controller_ids}
        self.broker_ports={n:allocate() for n in self.broker_ids}
        self.sasl_ports={n:allocate() for n in self.broker_ids} if sasl else {}
        self.bootstrap=','.join(f'127.0.0.1:{self.broker_ports[n]}' for n in self.broker_ids)
        self.controller_bootstrap=','.join(f'127.0.0.1:{self.controller_ports[n]}' for n in self.controller_ids)
        self.sasl_bootstrap=','.join(f'127.0.0.1:{self.sasl_ports[n]}' for n in self.broker_ids) if sasl else None
        self.password='s02-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.processes={};self.logs={};self.configs={};self.commands={}
        voters=','.join(f'{n}@127.0.0.1:{self.controller_ports[n]}' for n in self.controller_ids)
        (self.root/'java-tmp').mkdir()
        self.command=[str(self.java),'-XX:-UsePerfData','-Djava.io.tmpdir='+str(self.root/'java-tmp'),'-Xms32m','-Xmx256m','-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1',
            '-Dlog4j2.configurationFile='+str(self.home/'config/log4j2.yaml'),
            '-Dkafka.logs.dir='+str(self.root/'java-logs'),'-cp',str(self.home/'libs/*')]
        self.cluster_id=base64.urlsafe_b64encode(uuid.uuid4().bytes).decode().rstrip('=')
        for n in self.controller_ids+self.broker_ids:
            controller=n in self.controller_ids
            node=self.root/str(n);node.mkdir()
            settings={'process.roles':'controller' if controller else 'broker','node.id':str(n),
                'controller.quorum.voters':voters,'controller.listener.names':'CONTROLLER',
                'listener.security.protocol.map':'PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT'+(',SASL_PLAINTEXT:SASL_PLAINTEXT' if sasl else ''),
                'inter.broker.listener.name':'PLAINTEXT','log.dirs':str(node/'data'),
                'num.partitions':'2','offsets.topic.replication.factor':str(min(brokers,3)),
                'offsets.topic.num.partitions':'1','transaction.state.log.replication.factor':str(min(brokers,3)),
                'transaction.state.log.min.isr':'1','transaction.state.log.num.partitions':'1',
                'group.initial.rebalance.delay.ms':'0','auto.create.topics.enable':'false',
                'num.network.threads':'2','num.io.threads':'2','replica.lag.time.max.ms':'2000',
                'replica.fetch.wait.max.ms':'100','replica.socket.timeout.ms':'3000',
                'log.retention.check.interval.ms':'200','log.segment.delete.delay.ms':'100',
                'log.retention.ms':'-1',
                'log.cleaner.dedupe.buffer.size':'16777216',
                'controlled.shutdown.enable':'true'}
            if controller:
                settings['listeners']=f'CONTROLLER://127.0.0.1:{self.controller_ports[n]}'
            else:
                settings['listeners']=f'PLAINTEXT://127.0.0.1:{self.broker_ports[n]}'
                if sasl:settings['listeners']+=f',SASL_PLAINTEXT://127.0.0.1:{self.sasl_ports[n]}'
                settings['advertised.listeners']=settings['listeners']
                settings.update(overrides or {})
            if sasl:
                settings.update({'authorizer.class.name':'org.apache.kafka.metadata.authorizer.StandardAuthorizer',
                    'super.users':'User:admin;User:ANONYMOUS','allow.everyone.if.no.acl.found':'false'})
                if not controller:
                    settings['sasl.enabled.mechanisms']='PLAIN'
                    settings['listener.name.sasl_plaintext.plain.sasl.jaas.config']=(
                        'org.apache.kafka.common.security.plain.PlainLoginModule required '
                        f'user_admin="{self.password}" user_reader="{self.password}" user_alice="{self.password}" user_bob="{self.password}";')
            conf=node/'server.properties';conf.write_text(''.join(f'{k}={v}\n' for k,v in settings.items()))
            resource_event({'event':'configuration','node_id':n,'path':str(conf),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(conf.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'redacted_settings':{k:('[ephemeral JAAS redacted]' if k.endswith('sasl.jaas.config') else v) for k,v in settings.items()}})
            self.configs[n]=conf
            p=subprocess.run(self.command+['kafka.tools.StorageTool','format','--cluster-id='+self.cluster_id,'-c',str(conf)],
                text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=20)
            resource_event({'event':'storage_format','command':p.args,'returncode':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr})
            assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
        (self.root/'client.properties').write_text('request.timeout.ms=2000\ndefault.api.timeout.ms=3000\n')
        (self.root/'cli-log4j2.xml').write_text('<Configuration status="ERROR"><Appenders><Console name="stderr" target="SYSTEM_ERR"><PatternLayout pattern="%m%n"/></Console></Appenders><Loggers><Root level="error"><AppenderRef ref="stderr"/></Root></Loggers></Configuration>')

    def start(self,n):
        assert n in self.configs and (n not in self.processes or self.processes[n].poll() is not None)
        log=open(self.root/str(n)/'server.log','a+')
        expected_parent=os.getpid()
        def guard():
            if ctypes.CDLL(None).prctl(1,signal.SIGKILL,0,0,0)!=0 or os.getppid()!=expected_parent:os._exit(125)
        cmd=self.command+['kafka.Kafka',str(self.configs[n])]
        p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=log,start_new_session=True,preexec_fn=guard)
        self.processes[n]=p;self.logs[n]=log
        ports=[self.controller_ports[n]] if n in self.controller_ids else [self.broker_ports[n]]+([self.sasl_ports[n]] if n in self.sasl_ports else [])
        manifest={'event':'start','pid':p.pid,'pgid':p.pid,'directory':str(self.root),
            'node_id':n,'ports':ports,'command':cmd}
        resource_event(manifest)
        print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_START:'+json.dumps({k:v for k,v in manifest.items() if k not in ('event','command')}),flush=True)

    def stop(self,n):
        p=self.processes[n]
        if p.poll() is None:
            os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
            try:p.wait(timeout=8)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);p.wait(timeout=5)
        self.logs[n].close()
        resource_event({'event':'process_reaped','pid':p.pid,'node_id':n})
        print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_PROCESS_REAPED:'+str(p.pid),flush=True)

    def ready(self, expected=None, timeout=35):
        expected=set(expected if expected is not None else self.broker_ids)
        a=AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0});deadline=time.monotonic()+timeout
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            for n,p in self.processes.items():
                if p.poll() is not None and n in expected:
                    raise AssertionError((self.root/str(n)/'server.log').read_text()[-6000:])
            try:
                md=a.list_topics(timeout=2)
                if expected<=set(md.brokers):return a
            except KafkaException as e:
                if e.args[0].code() not in (-195,-187,-185,-158,14,15,16):raise
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise AssertionError('native cluster readiness timeout: '+str(expected))

    def create(self,partitions=1,replicas=None,config=None,assignment=None):
        a=AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0});name='s02c-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
        spec=NewTopic(name,partitions,replicas or len(self.broker_ids),config=config or {}) if assignment is None else NewTopic(name,len(assignment),replica_assignment=assignment,config=config or {})
        a.create_topics([spec])[name].result(10)
        for part in range(len(assignment) if assignment else partitions):
            self.wait_isr(name,len(assignment[part]) if assignment else replicas or len(self.broker_ids),p=part)
        return name

    def partition(self,name,p=0):
        return AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0}).list_topics(name,timeout=3).topics[name].partitions[p]

    def wait_isr(self,name,count,p=0,timeout=15):
        deadline=time.monotonic()+timeout
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            try:
                md=self.partition(name,p)
                if md.leader>=0 and len(md.isrs)==count:return md
            except (KafkaException,KeyError):pass
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise AssertionError('ISR did not reach '+str(count))

    def cli(self,main,args,timeout=12):
        cmd=self.command+['-Dlog4j2.configurationFile='+str(self.root/'cli-log4j2.xml'),main,*args]
        result=subprocess.run(cmd,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout)
        print('NATIVE_CLI:'+json.dumps({'command':cmd,'rc':result.returncode,'output':result.stdout[-3500:],'stderr':result.stderr[-1500:]}),flush=True)
        return result

    def quorum_command(self):
        return self.command+['-Dlog4j2.configurationFile='+str(self.root/'cli-log4j2.xml'),'org.apache.kafka.tools.MetadataQuorumCommand','--bootstrap-controller',self.controller_bootstrap,

        spec=NewTopic(name,partitions,replicas or len(self.broker_ids),config=config or {}) if assignment is None else NewTopic(name,len(assignment),replica_assignment=assignment,config=config or {})
        a.create_topics([spec])[name].result(10)

title: 增加分区为什么可能影响同一键的顺序？
answer:
很多分区算法会根据键的哈希和分区数来决定位置。分区数一变，同一个键后续可能被分到别的分区。

顺序通常是在分区内保证的，所以扩分区前要评估同一键的新旧消息怎么衔接。

def murmur2_positive(data):
    m=0x5bd1e995;h=(0x9747b28c^len(data))&0xffffffff;offset=0
    while offset+4<=len(data):
        k=int.from_bytes(data[offset:offset+4],'little');k=(k*m)&0xffffffff;k^=k>>24;k=(k*m)&0xffffffff
        h=((h*m)&0xffffffff)^k;offset+=4
    tail=data[offset:]
    if len(tail)==3:h^=tail[2]<<16
    if len(tail)>=2:h^=tail[1]<<8
    if tail:h^=tail[0];h=(h*m)&0xffffffff
    h^=h>>13;h=(h*m)&0xffffffff;h^=h>>15
    return h&0x7fffffff
with cluster(1,1) as box:
    a=AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':box.bootstrap,'log_level':0});name=box.create(partitions=2);identity=topic_uuid(a,name)
    remapped=[];stable=[]
    while len(remapped)<12 or len(stable)<12:
        candidate=('k'+uuid.uuid4().hex).encode();changed_route=murmur2_positive(candidate)%2!=murmur2_positive(candidate)%3
        target=remapped if changed_route else stable
        if len(target)<12:target.append(candidate)
    keys=remapped+stable
    before_records=[(k,k+b':old') for k in keys];before=task.emit(box.bootstrap,name,before_records)
    assert len(before)==len(keys) and all(x['partition']==murmur2_positive(x['key'].encode())%2 for x in before)
    a.create_partitions([NewPartitions(name,3)])[name].result(8)
    for part in range(3):box.wait_isr(name,1,p=part)
    after_records=[(k,k+b':new') for k in keys];after=task.emit(box.bootstrap,name,after_records)
    assert len(after)==len(keys) and topic_uuid(a,name)==identity
    messages=collect(box.bootstrap,name,3,len(keys)*2);actual={(m.key().decode(),m.value().decode()):(m.partition(),m.offset()) for m in messages}
    for result in before+after:assert actual[(result['key'],result['value'])]==(result['partition'],result['offset'])
    # Independent real native producer with the same explicitly declared partitioner is the mapping oracle.
    oracle=producer(box.bootstrap,partitioner='murmur2');expected={}
    for key in keys:oracle.produce(name,key=key,value=b'oracle',on_delivery=lambda e,m:expected.__setitem__(m.key().decode(),m.partition()) if e is None else None)
    assert oracle.flush(8)==0 and len(expected)==len(keys)
    assert all(x['partition']==expected[x['key']] for x in after)
    changed=sorted(x['key'] for x in before if x['partition']!=expected[x['key']]);assert changed,'random native corpus unexpectedly had no remapped key'
    result=task.routing_change(before,after)
    assert result=={'changed_keys':changed,'partition_local_order_only':True,'cross_partition_handoff_required':True}
    for key in changed:
        old=next(x for x in before if x['key']==key);new=next(x for x in after if x['key']==key)

    assert task.routing_change(after,after)=={'changed_keys':[],'partition_local_order_only':True,'cross_partition_handoff_required':False}
    # The [new,old] example above illustrates a legal merge of distinct partitions;
    # it is not presented as an observed cross-partition consumer scheduling trace.
    print('NATIVE_PARTITION_EXPANSION_ACTUAL_SAME_KEY_ROUTE_CHANGE_WITHOUT_GLOBAL_ORDER_CLAIM',flush=True)

def coordinator_retry(operation):
    """Retry only native coordinator discovery transitions, never semantic errors."""
    deadline = time.monotonic()+6

            error = exc.args[0]

                'controlled.shutdown.enable':'true'}
            if controller:

            conf=node/'server.properties';conf.write_text(''.join(f'{k}={v}\n' for k,v in settings.items()))
            resource_event({'event':'configuration','node_id':n,'path':str(conf),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(conf.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'redacted_settings':{k:('[ephemeral JAAS redacted]' if k.endswith('sasl.jaas.config') else v) for k,v in settings.items()}})
            self.configs[n]=conf
            p=subprocess.run(self.command+['kafka.tools.StorageTool','format','--cluster-id='+self.cluster_id,'-c',str(conf)],

    def start(self,n):
        assert n in self.configs and (n not in self.processes or self.processes[n].poll() is not None)
        log=open(self.root/str(n)/'server.log','a+')
        expected_parent=os.getpid()
        def guard():
            if ctypes.CDLL(None).prctl(1,signal.SIGKILL,0,0,0)!=0 or os.getppid()!=expected_parent:os._exit(125)
        cmd=self.command+['kafka.Kafka',str(self.configs[n])]
        p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=log,start_new_session=True,preexec_fn=guard)
        self.processes[n]=p;self.logs[n]=log
        ports=[self.controller_ports[n]] if n in self.controller_ids else [self.broker_ports[n]]+([self.sasl_ports[n]] if n in self.sasl_ports else [])
        manifest={'event':'start','pid':p.pid,'pgid':p.pid,'directory':str(self.root),
            'node_id':n,'ports':ports,'command':cmd}
        resource_event(manifest)
        print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_START:'+json.dumps({k:v for k,v in manifest.items() if k not in ('event','command')}),flush=True)

    def stop(self,n):
        p=self.processes[n]
        if p.poll() is None:
            os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
            try:p.wait(timeout=8)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);p.wait(timeout=5)
        self.logs[n].close()
        resource_event({'event':'process_reaped','pid':p.pid,'node_id':n})
        print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_PROCESS_REAPED:'+str(p.pid),flush=True)

    def ready(self, expected=None, timeout=35):
        expected=set(expected if expected is not None else self.broker_ids)
        a=AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0});deadline=time.monotonic()+timeout
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            for n,p in self.processes.items():
                if p.poll() is not None and n in expected:
                    raise AssertionError((self.root/str(n)/'server.log').read_text()[-6000:])
            try:
                md=a.list_topics(timeout=2)
                if expected<=set(md.brokers):return a
            except KafkaException as e:
                if e.args[0].code() not in (-195,-187,-185,-158,14,15,16):raise
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise AssertionError('native cluster readiness timeout: '+str(expected))

    def create(self,partitions=1,replicas=None,config=None,assignment=None):
        a=AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0});name='s02c-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
        spec=NewTopic(name,partitions,replicas or len(self.broker_ids),config=config or {}) if assignment is None else NewTopic(name,len(assignment),replica_assignment=assignment,config=config or {})
        a.create_topics([spec])[name].result(10)
        for part in range(len(assignment) if assignment else partitions):
            self.wait_isr(name,len(assignment[part]) if assignment else replicas or len(self.broker_ids),p=part)
        return name

    def partition(self,name,p=0):
        return AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':self.bootstrap,'log_level':0}).list_topics(name,timeout=3).topics[name].partitions[p]

    def wait_isr(self,name,count,p=0,timeout=15):
        deadline=time.monotonic()+timeout
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            try:
                md=self.partition(name,p)
                if md.leader>=0 and len(md.isrs)==count:return md
            except (KafkaException,KeyError):pass
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise AssertionError('ISR did not reach '+str(count))

    def cli(self,main,args,timeout=12):
        cmd=self.command+['-Dlog4j2.configurationFile='+str(self.root/'cli-log4j2.xml'),main,*args]
        result=subprocess.run(cmd,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout)
        print('NATIVE_CLI:'+json.dumps({'command':cmd,'rc':result.returncode,'output':result.stdout[-3500:],'stderr':result.stderr[-1500:]}),flush=True)
        return result

    def quorum_command(self):
        return self.command+['-Dlog4j2.configurationFile='+str(self.root/'cli-log4j2.xml'),'org.apache.kafka.tools.MetadataQuorumCommand','--bootstrap-controller',self.controller_bootstrap,
            '--command-config',str(self.root/'client.properties'),'describe','--status']


@contextlib.contextmanager
def cluster(brokers=3,controllers=1,overrides=None,sasl=False):
    d=None
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='session02-kafka-d-') as d:
            box=NativeCluster(d,brokers,controllers,overrides,sasl)
            try:
                for n in box.controller_ids+box.broker_ids:box.start(n)
                box.ready()
                print('NATIVE_KAFKA_4_CLUSTER_READY:'+json.dumps({'brokers':box.broker_ids,'controllers':box.controller_ids}),flush=True)
                yield box
            finally:
                try:
                    for n in box.broker_ids+box.controller_ids:
                        if n in box.processes:box.stop(n)
                finally:
                    for path in sorted(box.root.rglob('*')):
                        if path.is_file() and (path.name in ('server.log','streams-native.log') or box.root/'java-logs' in path.parents):
                            raw=path.read_bytes();resource_event({'event':'full_native_log','path':str(path),'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'base64':base64.b64encode(raw).decode()})
    finally:
        if d is not None:
            assert not Path(d).exists()
            resource_event({'event':'directory_removed','directory':d})
            print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY_REMOVED:'+d,flush=True)

 NewPartitions,AclBinding,AclBindingFilter,AclOperation,AclPermissionType,ResourcePatternType)

def configs(admin,kind,name):
    r=ConfigResource(kind,str(name));return admin.describe_configs([r])[r].result(8)

def config_set(admin,kind,name,values):
    r=ConfigResource(kind,str(name),incremental_configs=[ConfigEntry(k,str(v) if v is not None else None,
        incremental_operation=AlterConfigOpType.DELETE if v is None else AlterConfigOpType.SET) for k,v in values.items()])
    admin.incremental_alter_configs([r])[r].result(8)

def topic_uuid(admin,name):
    return str(admin.describe_topics(TopicCollection([name]))[name].result(8).topic_id)

def cli_command(box):return box.command+['kafka.admin.ConfigCommand','--bootstrap-server',box.bootstrap]

def cli_config(command,*args):
    p=subprocess.run([*command,*args],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=12)
    resource_event({'event':'cli','command':p.args,'returncode':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr})
    assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
    return p.stdout

def collect(bs,name,partitions,count):
    c=consumer(bs);out=[]
    try:
        c.assign([TopicPartition(name,p,0) for p in range(partitions)]);end=time.monotonic()+12
        while len(out)<count and time.monotonic()<end:
            m=c.poll(.2)
            if m and not m.error():out.append(m)
        assert len(out)==count,(len(out),count)
        return out
    finally:c.close()

def wait_until(fn,timeout=18):
    end=time.monotonic()+timeout
    while True:
        result=fn()
        if result:return result
        assert time.monotonic()<end,'native condition did not become true'
        time.sleep(.1)

def all_acls(admin):
    f=AclBindingFilter(ResourceType.ANY,None,ResourcePatternType.ANY,None,None,AclOperation.ANY,AclPermissionType.ANY)
    return admin.describe_acls(f).result(8)

def acl_keys(rows):
    return {(x.restype,x.name,x.resource_pattern_type,x.principal,x.host,x.operation,x.permission_type) for x in rows}

_original_trace=traced
def traced(function):
    original=_original_trace(function)
    def call(*args,**kwargs):
        resource_event({'event':'student_operation_entered','function':function.__name__})
        expected=subprocess.run
        try:return original(*args,**kwargs)
        finally:
            if subprocess.run is not expected:
                subprocess.run=expected
                raise AssertionError('native CLI transport was replaced')
    return call

with cluster(3,1,overrides={'replica.fetch.max.bytes':'262144','replica.fetch.response.max.bytes':'524288'}) as box:
    a=AdminClient({'bootstrap.servers':box.bootstrap,'log_level':0});name=box.create(assignment=[[1]])
    config_set(a,ResourceType.BROKER,1,{'leader.replication.throttled.rate':'77777'})
    config_set(a,ResourceType.BROKER,3,{'leader.replication.throttled.rate':'88888'})
    config_set(a,ResourceType.TOPIC,name,{'leader.replication.throttled.replicas':'0:3'})
    def snapshot():
        return {str(n):{k:(v.value,ConfigSource(v.source).name) for k,v in configs(a,ResourceType.BROKER,n).items() if k in ('leader.replication.throttled.rate','follower.replication.throttled.rate')} for n in [1,2,3]}
    def topic_snapshot():return {k:(v.value,ConfigSource(v.source).name) for k,v in configs(a,ResourceType.TOPIC,name).items() if 'replication.throttled.replicas' in k}
    def observe_config_state(phase):
        brokers=snapshot();topic=topic_snapshot()
        resource_event({'event':'native_throttle_config_observation','phase':phase,'monotonic':time.monotonic(),'brokers':brokers,'topic':topic})
        return brokers,topic
    def wait_exact_config_state(phase,predicate):
        deadline=time.monotonic()+4
        while True:
            brokers,topic=observe_config_state(phase)
            if predicate(brokers,topic):return
            assert time.monotonic()<deadline,phase+' native configurations did not converge: '+json.dumps({'brokers':brokers,'topic':topic},sort_keys=True)
            time.sleep(.05)
    def assert_applied(rate,phase='apply'):
        def exact(brokers,topic):
            for broker in ['1','2']:
                for key in ['leader.replication.throttled.rate','follower.replication.throttled.rate']:
                    if brokers[broker].get(key)!=(str(rate),'DYNAMIC_BROKER_CONFIG'):return False
            for key in ['leader.replication.throttled.replicas','follower.replication.throttled.replicas']:
                value=topic.get(key)
                if value is None or value[0] is None or set(value[0].split(','))!={'0:1','0:2'} or value[1]!='DYNAMIC_TOPIC_CONFIG':return False
            return brokers['3']==initial['3']
        wait_exact_config_state(phase+'-'+str(rate),exact)
    def baseline_native_ready():
        brokers,topic=observe_config_state('baseline')
        return brokers['1'].get('leader.replication.throttled.rate',(None,None))[0]=='77777' and brokers['3'].get('leader.replication.throttled.rate',(None,None))[0]=='88888' and topic.get('leader.replication.throttled.replicas',(None,None))[0]=='0:3'
    wait_until(baseline_native_ready,8)
    initial=snapshot();topic_initial={k:(v.value,ConfigSource(v.source).name) for k,v in configs(a,ResourceType.TOPIC,name).items() if 'replication.throttled.replicas' in k}
    payload=uuid.uuid4().bytes*11000
    send(box.bootstrap,name,[(0,payload+str(i).encode(),int(time.time()*1000)) for i in range(36)])
    for rate,brokers in [(0,[1,2]),(True,[1,2]),(8192,[1,1]),(8192,[1,99])]:
        try:task.apply(a,name,brokers,rate)
        except ValueError:pass
        else:raise AssertionError('invalid throttling plan must reject before mutation')
        assert snapshot()==initial and topic_snapshot()==topic_initial
    low=task.apply(a,name,[1,2],8192);high=None
    try:
        assert_applied(8192)
        assert snapshot()['3']==initial['3']
        plan=Path('move.json');plan.write_text(json.dumps({'version':1,'partitions':[{'topic':name,'partition':0,'replicas':[1,2]}]}))
        command=box.command+['org.apache.kafka.tools.reassign.ReassignPartitionsCommand','--bootstrap-server',box.bootstrap,'--reassignment-json-file',str(plan),'--execute']
        native=subprocess.run(command,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=15)
        resource_event({'event':'cli','command':command,'returncode':native.returncode,'stdout':native.stdout,'stderr':native.stderr})
        assert native.returncode==0,native.stderr
        time.sleep(2);assert len(box.partition(name).isrs)==1,'low native rate unexpectedly completed entire bounded corpus'
        timings=[]
        for _ in range(3):
            t=time.monotonic();send(box.bootstrap,name,[(0,b'foreground-'+uuid.uuid4().bytes,int(time.time()*1000))]);timings.append(time.monotonic()-t)
        high=task.apply(a,name,[1,2],512*1024);assert_applied(512*1024)
        assert len(box.partition(name).isrs)==1,'high-rate foreground observation must overlap incomplete migration'
        high_timings=[];high_window_start=time.monotonic()
        for _ in range(3):
            t=time.monotonic();send(box.bootstrap,name,[(0,b'high-foreground-'+uuid.uuid4().bytes,int(time.time()*1000))]);high_timings.append(time.monotonic()-t)
        high_window_end=time.monotonic();assert len(box.partition(name).isrs)==1,'migration completed before bounded high-rate observation; no pressure sample claimed'
        box.wait_isr(name,2,timeout=20)
        resource_event({'event':'foreground_reassignment_measurements','low_ack_seconds':timings,'high_ack_seconds':high_timings,'high_window_start':high_window_start,'high_window_end':high_window_end,'high_overlap_incomplete_isr':True})
        assert snapshot()['3']==initial['3']
        print('NATIVE_THROTTLED_REASSIGNMENT_ACK_SECONDS:'+json.dumps(timings),flush=True)
    finally:
        try:
            if high is not None:
                task.restore(a,high);assert_applied(8192,'restore-high-to-low')
        finally:task.restore(a,low)
    resource_event({'event':'restore_native_state_before_convergence','initial_brokers':initial,'current_brokers':snapshot(),'initial_topic':topic_initial,'current_topic':topic_snapshot()})
    wait_exact_config_state('restore-final',lambda brokers,topic:brokers==initial and topic==topic_initial)
    assert snapshot()==initial
    assert {k:(v.value,ConfigSource(v.source).name) for k,v in configs(a,ResourceType.TOPIC,name).items() if 'replication.throttled.replicas' in k}==topic_initial
    assert set(box.partition(name).replicas)=={1,2}
    print('NATIVE_LOW_RATE_DELAY_HIGHER_RATE_FINISHES_AND_TEMPORARY_CONFIGS_RESTORED',flush=True)
